kjv.19:15: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
kjv.19:16: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that [were] beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer [went] before them.
kjv.19:17: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set [the battle] in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
kjv.19:18: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand [men which fought in] chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.
kjv.19:19: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.
kjv.20:1: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out [to battle], Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.
kjv.20:2: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and [there were] precious stones in it; and it was set upon David's head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.
kjv.20:3: And he brought out the people that [were] in it, and cut [them] with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
kjv.20:4: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, [that was] of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.
kjv.20:5: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff [was] like a weaver's beam.
kjv.20:6: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of [great] stature, whose fingers and toes [were] four and twenty, six [on each hand], and six [on each foot]: and he also was the son of the giant.
kjv.20:7: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother slew him.
kjv.20:8: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
kjv.21:1: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.
kjv.21:2: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beer-sheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know [it].
kjv.21:3: And Joab answered, The LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as they [be]: but, my lord the king, [are] they not all my lord's servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?
kjv.21:4: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
kjv.21:5: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all [they of] Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah [was] four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.
kjv.21:6: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king's word was abominable to Joab.
kjv.21:7: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.
kjv.21:8: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
kjv.21:9: And the LORD spake unto Gad, David's seer, saying,
kjv.21:10: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three [things]: choose thee one of them, that I may do [it] unto thee.
kjv.21:11: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Choose thee
kjv.21:12: Either three years' famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh [thee]; or else three days the sword of the LORD, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.
kjv.21:13: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD; for very great [are] his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.
kjv.21:14: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
kjv.21:15: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the LORD beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
kjv.21:16: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders [of Israel, who were] clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
kjv.21:17: And David said unto God, [Is it] not I [that] commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but [as for] these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O LORD my God, be on me, and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.
kjv.21:18: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
kjv.21:19: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the LORD.
kjv.21:20: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
kjv.21:21: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with [his] face to the ground.
kjv.21:22: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of [this] threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.
kjv.21:23: And Ornan said unto David, Take [it] to thee, and let my lord the king do [that which is] good in his eyes: lo, I give [thee] the oxen [also] for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.
kjv.21:24: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take [that] which [is] thine for the LORD, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.
kjv.21:25: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
kjv.21:26: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the LORD; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.
kjv.21:27: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.
kjv.21:28: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
kjv.21:29: For the tabernacle of the LORD, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, [were] at that season in the high place at Gibeon.
kjv.21:30: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD.
kjv.22:1: Then David said, This [is] the house of the LORD God, and this [is] the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.
kjv.22:2: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that [were] in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
kjv.22:3: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
kjv.22:4: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.
kjv.22:5: And David said, Solomon my son [is] young and tender, and the house [that is] to be builded for the LORD [must be] exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will [therefore] now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.
kjv.22:6: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the LORD God of Israel.
kjv.22:7: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God:
kjv.22:8: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
kjv.22:9: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
kjv.22:10: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I [will be] his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
kjv.22:11: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.
kjv.22:12: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.
kjv.22:13: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.
kjv.22:14: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.
kjv.22:15: Moreover [there are] workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.
kjv.22:16: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, [there is] no number. Arise [therefore], and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.
kjv.22:17: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, [saying],
kjv.22:18: [Is] not the LORD your God with you? and hath he [not] given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD, and before his people.
kjv.22:19: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD.
kjv.23:1: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
kjv.23:2: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
kjv.23:3: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
kjv.23:4: Of which, twenty and four thousand [were] to set forward the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand [were] officers and judges:
kjv.23:5: Moreover four thousand [were] porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, [said David], to praise [therewith].
kjv.23:6: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, [namely], Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
kjv.23:7: Of the Gershonites [were], Laadan, and Shimei.
kjv.23:8: The sons of Laadan; the chief [was] Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
kjv.23:9: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These [were] the chief of the fathers of Laadan.
kjv.23:10: And the sons of Shimei [were], Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four [were] the sons of Shimei.
kjv.23:11: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to [their] father's house.
kjv.23:12: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
kjv.23:13: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.
kjv.23:14: Now [concerning] Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
kjv.23:15: The sons of Moses [were], Gershom, and Eliezer.
kjv.23:16: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel [was] the chief.
kjv.23:17: And the sons of Eliezer [were], Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
kjv.23:18: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.
kjv.23:19: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
kjv.23:20: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah the first, and Jesiah the second.
kjv.23:21: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.
kjv.23:22: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
kjv.23:23: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
kjv.23:24: These [were] the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; [even] the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from the age of twenty years and upward.
kjv.23:25: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:
kjv.23:26: And also unto the Levites; they shall no [more] carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.
kjv.23:27: For by the last words of David the Levites [were] numbered from twenty years old and above:
kjv.23:28: Because their office [was] to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;
kjv.23:29: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for [that which is baked in] the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;
kjv.23:30: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;
kjv.23:31: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD:
kjv.23:32: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy [place], and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD.
kjv.24:1: Now [these are] the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
kjv.24:2: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.
kjv.24:3: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.
kjv.24:4: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and [thus] were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar [there were] sixteen chief men of the house of [their] fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.
kjv.24:5: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors [of the house] of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
kjv.24:6: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, [one] of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and [before] the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and [one] taken for Ithamar.
kjv.24:7: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
kjv.24:8: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
kjv.24:9: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
kjv.24:10: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
kjv.24:11: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
kjv.24:12: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
kjv.24:13: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
kjv.24:14: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
kjv.24:15: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
kjv.24:16: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
kjv.24:17: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
kjv.24:18: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
kjv.24:19: These [were] the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.
kjv.24:20: And the rest of the sons of Levi [were these]: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
kjv.24:21: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first [was] Isshiah.
kjv.24:22: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.
kjv.24:23: And the sons [of Hebron]; Jeriah [the first], Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
kjv.24:24: [Of] the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
kjv.24:25: The brother of Michah [was] Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.
kjv.24:26: The sons of Merari [were] Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.
kjv.24:27: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
kjv.24:28: Of Mahli [came] Eleazar, who had no sons.
kjv.24:29: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish [was] Jerahmeel.
kjv.24:30: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These [were] the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.
kjv.24:31: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.
kjv.25:1: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
kjv.25:2: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.
kjv.25:3: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD.
kjv.25:4: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, [and] Mahazioth:
kjv.25:5: All these [were] the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
kjv.25:6: All these [were] under the hands of their father for song [in] the house of the LORD, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
kjv.25:7: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD, [even] all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
kjv.25:8: And they cast lots, ward against [ward], as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
kjv.25:9: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons [were] twelve:
kjv.25:10: The third to Zaccur, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:11: The fourth to Izri, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:12: The fifth to Nethaniah, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:13: The sixth to Bukkiah, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:14: The seventh to Jesharelah, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:15: The eighth to Jeshaiah, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:16: The ninth to Mattaniah, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:17: The tenth to Shimei, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:18: The eleventh to Azareel, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:19: The twelfth to Hashabiah, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:20: The thirteenth to Shubael, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:21: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:22: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:23: The sixteenth to Hananiah, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:24: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:25: The eighteenth to Hanani, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:26: The nineteenth to Mallothi, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:27: The twentieth to Eliathah, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:28: The one and twentieth to Hothir, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:29: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:30: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve:
kjv.25:31: The four and twentieth to Romamti-ezer, [he], his sons, and his brethren, [were] twelve.
kjv.26:1: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites [was] Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
kjv.26:2: And the sons of Meshelemiah [were], Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
kjv.26:3: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
kjv.26:4: Moreover the sons of Obed-edom [were], Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,
kjv.26:5: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.
kjv.26:6: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they [were] mighty men of valour.
kjv.26:7: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren [were] strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
kjv.26:8: All these of the sons of Obed-edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, [were] threescore and two of Obed-edom.
kjv.26:9: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.
kjv.26:10: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for [though] he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)
kjv.26:11: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah [were] thirteen.
kjv.26:12: Among these [were] the divisions of the porters, [even] among the chief men, [having] wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD.
kjv.26:13: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.
kjv.26:14: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
kjv.26:15: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.
kjv.26:16: To Shuppim and Hosah [the lot came forth] westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.
kjv.26:17: Eastward [were] six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two [and] two.
kjv.26:18: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, [and] two at Parbar.
kjv.26:19: These [are] the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.
kjv.26:20: And of the Levites, Ahijah [was] over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
kjv.26:21: [As concerning] the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, [even] of Laadan the Gershonite, [were] Jehieli.
kjv.26:22: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, [which were] over the treasures of the house of the LORD.
kjv.26:23: Of the Amramites, [and] the Izharites, the Hebronites, [and] the Uzzielites:
kjv.26:24: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, [was] ruler of the treasures.
kjv.26:25: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
kjv.26:26: Which Shelomith and his brethren [were] over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
kjv.26:27: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD.
kjv.26:28: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; [and] whosoever had dedicated [any thing, it was] under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.
kjv.26:29: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons [were] for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
kjv.26:30: [And] of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, [were] officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.
kjv.26:31: Among the Hebronites [was] Jerijah the chief, [even] among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.
kjv.26:32: And his brethren, men of valour, [were] two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.
kjv.27:1: Now the children of Israel after their number, [to wit], the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course [were] twenty and four thousand.
kjv.27:2: Over the first course for the first month [was] Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.
kjv.27:3: Of the children of Perez [was] the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
kjv.27:4: And over the course of the second month [was] Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course [was] Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise [were] twenty and four thousand.
kjv.27:5: The third captain of the host for the third month [was] Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.
kjv.27:6: This [is that] Benaiah, [who was] mighty [among] the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course [was] Ammizabad his son.
kjv.27:7: The fourth [captain] for the fourth month [was] Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.
kjv.27:8: The fifth captain for the fifth month [was] Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.
kjv.27:9: The sixth [captain] for the sixth month [was] Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.
kjv.27:10: The seventh [captain] for the seventh month [was] Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.
kjv.27:11: The eighth [captain] for the eighth month [was] Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.
kjv.27:12: The ninth [captain] for the ninth month [was] Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.
kjv.27:13: The tenth [captain] for the tenth month [was] Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.
kjv.27:14: The eleventh [captain] for the eleventh month [was] Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.
kjv.27:15: The twelfth [captain] for the twelfth month [was] Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.
kjv.27:16: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites [was] Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:
kjv.27:17: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:
kjv.27:18: Of Judah, Elihu, [one] of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
kjv.27:19: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:
kjv.27:20: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
kjv.27:21: Of the half [tribe] of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
kjv.27:22: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These [were] the princes of the tribes of Israel.
kjv.27:23: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.
kjv.27:24: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.
kjv.27:25: And over the king's treasures [was] Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, [was] Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:
kjv.27:26: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground [was] Ezri the son of Chelub:
kjv.27:27: And over the vineyards [was] Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars [was] Zabdi the Shiphmite:
kjv.27:28: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that [were] in the low plains [was] Baal-hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil [was] Joash:
kjv.27:29: And over the herds that fed in Sharon [was] Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds [that were] in the valleys [was] Shaphat the son of Adlai:
kjv.27:30: Over the camels also [was] Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses [was] Jehdeiah the Meronothite:
kjv.27:31: And over the flocks [was] Jaziz the Hagerite. All these [were] the rulers of the substance which [was] king David's.
kjv.27:32: Also Jonathan David's uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni [was] with the king's sons:
kjv.27:33: And Ahithophel [was] the king's counsellor: and Hushai the Archite [was] the king's companion:
kjv.27:34: And after Ahithophel [was] Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army [was] Joab.
kjv.28:1: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.
kjv.28:2: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: [As for me], I [had] in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:
kjv.28:3: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou [hast been] a man of war, and hast shed blood.
kjv.28:4: Howbeit the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah [to be] the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make [me] king over all Israel:
kjv.28:5: And of all my sons, (for the LORD hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.
kjv.28:6: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him [to be] my son, and I will be his father.
kjv.28:7: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.
kjv.28:8: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave [it] for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.
kjv.28:9: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
kjv.28:10: Take heed now; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do [it].
kjv.28:11: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,
kjv.28:12: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the LORD, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:
kjv.28:13: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD.
kjv.28:14: [He gave] of gold by weight for [things] of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; [silver also] for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:
kjv.28:15: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, [both] for the candlestick, and [also] for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.
kjv.28:16: And by weight [he gave] gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and [likewise] silver for the tables of silver:
kjv.28:17: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons [he gave gold] by weight for every bason; and [likewise silver] by weight for every bason of silver:
kjv.28:18: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out [their wings], and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
kjv.28:19: All [this, said David], the LORD made me understand in writing by [his] hand upon me, [even] all the works of this pattern.
kjv.28:20: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do [it]: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, [even] my God, [will be] with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.
kjv.28:21: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, [even they shall be with thee] for all the service of the house of God: and [there shall be] with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people [will be] wholly at thy commandment.
kjv.29:1: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, [is yet] young and tender, and the work [is] great: for the palace [is] not for man, but for the LORD God.
kjv.29:2: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for [things to be made] of gold, and the silver for [things] of silver, and the brass for [things] of brass, the iron for [things] of iron, and wood for [things] of wood; onyx stones, and [stones] to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
kjv.29:3: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, [which] I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
kjv.29:4: [Even] three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses [withal]:
kjv.29:5: The gold for [things] of gold, and the silver for [things] of silver, and for all manner of work [to be made] by the hands of artificers. And who [then] is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the LORD?
kjv.29:6: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king's work, offered willingly,
kjv.29:7: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
kjv.29:8: And they with whom [precious] stones were found gave [them] to the treasure of the house of the LORD, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
kjv.29:9: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
kjv.29:10: Wherefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed [be] thou, LORD God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.
kjv.29:11: Thine, O LORD, [is] the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all [that is] in the heaven and in the earth [is thine]; thine [is] the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.
kjv.29:12: Both riches and honour [come] of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand [is] power and might; and in thine hand [it is] to make great, and to give strength unto all.
kjv.29:13: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
kjv.29:14: But who [am] I, and what [is] my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things [come] of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.
kjv.29:15: For we [are] strangers before thee, and sojourners, as [were] all our fathers: our days on the earth [are] as a shadow, and [there is] none abiding.
kjv.29:16: O LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name [cometh] of thine hand, and [is] all thine own.
kjv.29:17: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.
kjv.29:18: O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:
kjv.29:19: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all [these things], and to build the palace, [for] the which I have made provision.
kjv.29:20: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD your God. And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the LORD, and the king.
kjv.29:21: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings unto the LORD, on the morrow after that day, [even] a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, [and] a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:
kjv.29:22: And did eat and drink before the LORD on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed [him] unto the LORD [to be] the chief governor, and Zadok [to be] priest.
kjv.29:23: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
kjv.29:24: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.
kjv.29:25: And the LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him [such] royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
kjv.29:26: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
kjv.29:27: And the time that he reigned over Israel [was] forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three [years] reigned he in Jerusalem.
kjv.29:28: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
kjv.29:29: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they [are] written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,
kjv.29:30: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.

bsb.1:4: The sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
bsb.1:5: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
bsb.1:6: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
bsb.1:7: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.
bsb.1:8: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
bsb.1:9: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
bsb.1:10: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.
bsb.1:11: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,
bsb.1:12: the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.
bsb.1:13: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
bsb.1:14: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
bsb.1:15: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
bsb.1:16: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
bsb.1:17: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram. The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
bsb.1:18: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
bsb.1:19: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
bsb.1:20: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
bsb.1:23: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
bsb.1:24: So from Shem came Arphaxad, Shelah,
bsb.1:28: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.
bsb.1:30: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
bsb.1:31: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
bsb.1:32: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
bsb.1:33: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All of these were Keturah’s sons.
bsb.1:34: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
bsb.1:35: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
bsb.1:36: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz; and by Timna, Amalek.
bsb.1:37: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
bsb.1:38: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
bsb.1:39: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
bsb.1:40: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
bsb.1:41: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
bsb.1:42: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
bsb.1:43: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites: Bela son of Beor. His city was named Dinhabah.
bsb.1:44: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
bsb.1:45: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
bsb.1:46: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
bsb.1:47: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
bsb.1:48: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.
bsb.1:49: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
bsb.1:50: When Baal-hanan died, Hadad reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
bsb.1:51: Then Hadad died. Now the chiefs of Edom were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
bsb.1:54: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
bsb.2:1: These were the sons of Israel:
bsb.2:2: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
bsb.2:3: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanite. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD, who put him to death.
bsb.2:4: Tamar, Judah’s daughter-in-law, bore to him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.
bsb.2:5: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
bsb.2:6: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five in all.
bsb.2:7: The son of Carmi: Achar, who brought trouble upon Israel by violating the ban on devoted things.
bsb.2:9: The sons who were born to Hezron: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
bsb.2:10: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, a leader of the descendants of Judah.
bsb.2:11: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, and Salmon was the father of Boaz.
bsb.2:12: Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse.
bsb.2:13: Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn; Abinadab was born second, Shimea third,
bsb.2:16: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the three sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
bsb.2:17: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.
bsb.2:18: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah and by Jerioth. These were the sons of Azubah: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
bsb.2:19: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore to him Hur.
bsb.2:20: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri was the father of Bezalel.
bsb.2:21: Later, Hezron slept with the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead. He had married her when he was sixty years old, and she bore to him Segub.
bsb.2:22: Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
bsb.2:23: But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth-jair, along with Kenath and its sixty surrounding villages. All these were descendants of Machir the father of Gilead.
bsb.2:24: After Hezron died in Caleb-ephrathah, his wife Abijah bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
bsb.2:25: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron:
bsb.2:26: Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah. Jerahmeel had another wife named Atarah, who was the mother of Onam.
bsb.2:27: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
bsb.2:28: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai:
bsb.2:29: Nadab and Abishur. Abishur’s wife was named Abihail, and she bore to him Ahban and Molid.
bsb.2:30: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.
bsb.2:31: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
bsb.2:32: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.
bsb.2:33: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.
bsb.2:34: Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters; but he did have an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
bsb.2:35: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore to him Attai.
bsb.2:36: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan was the father of Zabad,
bsb.2:37: Zabad was the father of Ephlal, Ephlal was the father of Obed,
bsb.2:38: Obed was the father of Jehu, Jehu was the father of Azariah,
bsb.2:39: Azariah was the father of Helez, Helez was the father of Elasah,
bsb.2:40: Elasah was the father of Sismai, Sismai was the father of Shallum,
bsb.2:41: Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.
bsb.2:42: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and Mareshah his second son, who was the father of Hebron.
bsb.2:44: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema. Shema was the father of Raham the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem was the father of Shammai.
bsb.2:45: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
bsb.2:46: Caleb’s concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.
bsb.2:47: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
bsb.2:48: Caleb’s concubine Maacah was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.
bsb.2:49: She was also the mother of Shaaph father of Madmannah, and of Sheva father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb’s daughter was Acsah.
bsb.2:50: These were the descendants of Caleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah:
bsb.2:51: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim, Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
bsb.2:52: These were the descendants of Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim:
bsb.2:53: Haroeh, half the Manahathites, and the clans of Kiriath-jearim—the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites. From these descended the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.
bsb.2:55: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites, and the clans of the scribes who lived at Jabez—the Tirathites, Shimeathites, and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
bsb.3:1: These were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: The firstborn was Amnon by Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second was Daniel by Abigail of Carmel;
bsb.3:2: the third was Absalom the son of Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur; the fourth was Adonijah the son of Haggith;
bsb.3:3: the fifth was Shephatiah by Abital; and the sixth was Ithream by his wife Eglah.
bsb.3:4: These six sons were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months. And David reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three years,
bsb.3:5: and these sons were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. These four were born to him by Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel.
bsb.3:6: David’s other sons were Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet,
bsb.3:8: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet—nine in all.
bsb.3:9: These were all the sons of David, besides the sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister.
bsb.3:11: Abijah was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son, Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
bsb.3:12: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
bsb.3:13: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
bsb.3:14: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
bsb.3:15: The sons of Josiah: Johanan was the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second, Zedekiah the third, and Shallum the fourth.
bsb.3:16: The successors of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah.
bsb.3:17: The descendants of Jeconiah the captive:
bsb.3:18: Shealtiel his son, Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
bsb.3:19: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The children of Zerubbabel:
bsb.3:20: Meshullam and Hananiah, their sister Shelomith, and five others: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed.
bsb.3:21: The descendants of Hananiah: Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, of Arnan, of Obadiah, and of Shecaniah.
bsb.3:22: The six descendants of Shecaniah were Shemaiah and his sons: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
bsb.3:23: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam—three in all.
bsb.3:24: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani—seven in all.
bsb.4:1: The descendants of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
bsb.4:2: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.
bsb.4:3: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. And their sister was named Hazzelelponi.
bsb.4:4: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer was the father of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and the father of Bethlehem.
bsb.4:5: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
bsb.4:6: Naarah bore to him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.
bsb.4:7: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,
bsb.4:8: and Koz, who was the father of Anub and Zobebah and of the clans of Aharhel son of Harum.
bsb.4:9: Now Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him in pain.”
bsb.4:10: And Jabez called out to the God of Israel, “If only You would bless me and enlarge my territory! May Your hand be with me and keep me from harm, so that I will be free from pain.” And God granted the request of Jabez.
bsb.4:11: Chelub the brother of Shuhah was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
bsb.4:12: Eshton was the father of Beth-rapha, of Paseah, and of Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These were the men of Recah.
bsb.4:13: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai.
bsb.4:14: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah, and Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of those living in Ge-harashim, which was given this name because its people were craftsmen.
bsb.4:15: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
bsb.4:16: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
bsb.4:17: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon.
bsb.4:18: And Mered’s wife Bithiah gave birth to Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa. These were the children of Pharaoh’s daughter Bithiah. Mered also took a Judean wife, who gave birth to Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.
bsb.4:19: The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and of Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
bsb.4:20: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. The descendants of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
bsb.4:21: The sons of Shelah son of Judah:
bsb.4:22: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah and the clans of the linen workers at Beth-ashbea, Jokim, the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and Jashubi-lehem. (These names are from ancient records.)
bsb.4:23: These were the potters who lived at Netaim and Gederah. They lived there in the service of the king.
bsb.4:24: The descendants of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
bsb.4:25: The sons of Shaul: Shallum, Mibsam, and Mishma.
bsb.4:26: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel, Zaccur, and Shimei.
bsb.4:27: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children, so their whole clan did not become as numerous as the sons of Judah.
bsb.4:28: They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual,
bsb.4:31: Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, and Shaaraim. These were their cities until the reign of David.
bsb.4:32: And their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan—five towns—
bsb.4:33: and all their surrounding villages as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept a genealogical record:
bsb.4:34: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah,
bsb.4:35: Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah (son of Seraiah, son of Asiel),
bsb.4:36: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
bsb.4:37: and Ziza son of Shiphi (son of Allon, son of Jedaiah, son of Shimri, son of Shemaiah).
bsb.4:38: These men listed by name were the leaders of their clans. Their families increased greatly,
bsb.4:39: and they journeyed to the entrance of Gedor, to the east side of the valley, in search of pasture for their flocks.
bsb.4:40: There they found rich, good pasture, and the land was spacious, peaceful, and quiet; for some Hamites had lived there formerly.
bsb.4:41: These who were noted by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. They attacked the Hamites and Meunites there in their dwellings, devoting them to destruction even to this day. Then they settled in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks.
bsb.4:42: And five hundred of these Simeonites led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, went to Mount Seir
bsb.4:43: and struck down the remnant of the Amalekites who had escaped. And they have lived there to this day.
bsb.5:1: These were the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel. Though he was the firstborn, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph son of Israel, because Reuben defiled his father’s bed. So he is not reckoned according to birthright.
bsb.5:2: And though Judah prevailed over his brothers and a ruler came from him, the birthright belonged to Joseph.
bsb.5:3: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
bsb.5:5: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son, Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
bsb.5:6: and Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria carried into exile.
bsb.5:7: Beerah was a leader of the Reubenites. His relatives by their clans are recorded in their genealogy:
bsb.5:8: Jeiel the chief, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel. They settled in Aroer and as far as Nebo and Baal-meon.
bsb.5:9: They also settled in the east as far as the edge of the desert that extends to the Euphrates River, because their livestock had increased in the land of Gilead.
bsb.5:10: During the days of Saul they waged war against the Hagrites, who were defeated at their hands, and they occupied the homes of the Hagrites throughout the region east of Gilead.
bsb.5:11: The descendants of Gad lived next to the Reubenites in the land of Bashan, as far as Salecah:
bsb.5:12: Joel was the chief, Shapham the second, then Jaanai and Shaphat, who lived in Bashan.
bsb.5:13: Their kinsmen by families were Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber—seven in all.
bsb.5:14: These were the sons of Abihail son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz.
bsb.5:15: Ahi son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was head of their family.
bsb.5:16: They lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its towns, and throughout the pasturelands of Sharon.
bsb.5:17: All of them were reckoned in the genealogies during the reigns of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel.
bsb.5:18: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh had 44,760 warriors—valiant men who carried the shield and sword, drew the bow, and were trained for battle.
bsb.5:19: They waged war against the Hagrites, as well as Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
bsb.5:20: And because they cried out to God in battle, they were helped against their enemies, and the Hagrites and all their allies were delivered into their hands. Because they put their trust in God, He answered their prayers.
bsb.5:21: They seized the livestock of the Hagrites—50,000 camels, 250,000 sheep, and 2,000 donkeys. They also took 100,000 captives,
bsb.5:22: and many others fell slain, because the battle belonged to God. And they occupied the land until the exile.
bsb.5:23: Now the people of the half-tribe of Manasseh were numerous. They settled in the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon (that is, Senir, also known as Mount Hermon).
bsb.5:24: These were the heads of their families: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel.
bsb.5:25: They were mighty men of valor, famous men, and heads of their families. But they were unfaithful to the God of their fathers, and they prostituted themselves with the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.
bsb.5:26: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria (that is, Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria) to take the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. And he brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river of Gozan, where they remain to this day.
bsb.6:1: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
bsb.6:2: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
bsb.6:3: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
bsb.6:4: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas, Phinehas was the father of Abishua,
bsb.6:5: Abishua was the father of Bukki, Bukki was the father of Uzzi,
bsb.6:6: Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah, Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth,
bsb.6:7: Meraioth was the father of Amariah, Amariah was the father of Ahitub,
bsb.6:8: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz,
bsb.6:9: Ahimaaz was the father of Azariah, Azariah was the father of Johanan,
bsb.6:10: Johanan was the father of Azariah, who served as priest in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem,
bsb.6:11: Azariah was the father of Amariah, Amariah was the father of Ahitub,
bsb.6:12: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, Zadok was the father of Shallum,
bsb.6:13: Shallum was the father of Hilkiah, Hilkiah was the father of Azariah,
bsb.6:14: Azariah was the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah was the father of Jehozadak.
bsb.6:15: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
bsb.6:16: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
bsb.6:17: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
bsb.6:18: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
bsb.6:19: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites listed according to their fathers:
bsb.6:21: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son, Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
bsb.6:23: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son, Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
bsb.6:24: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
bsb.6:26: Amasai, Ahimoth, Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
bsb.6:27: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
bsb.6:28: The sons of Samuel: Joel his firstborn and Abijah his second son.
bsb.6:30: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son, Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, and Asaiah his son.
bsb.6:31: These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of the LORD after the ark rested there.
bsb.6:32: They ministered with song before the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, until Solomon built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem. And they performed their duties according to the regulations given them.
bsb.6:33: These are the men who served, together with their sons. From the Kohathites:
bsb.6:34: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel, the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
bsb.6:35: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
bsb.6:36: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
bsb.6:37: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
bsb.6:38: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
bsb.6:39: Heman’s kinsman was Asaph, who served at his right hand:
bsb.6:40: Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea, the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
bsb.6:41: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
bsb.6:42: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
bsb.6:43: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
bsb.6:44: On the left were their kinsmen, the sons of Merari:
bsb.6:45: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
bsb.6:46: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
bsb.6:47: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
bsb.6:48: Their fellow Levites were assigned to every kind of service of the tabernacle, the house of God.
bsb.6:49: But Aaron and his sons did all the work of the Most Holy Place. They presented the offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
bsb.6:50: These were the descendants of Aaron:
bsb.6:51: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son, Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
bsb.6:52: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
bsb.6:53: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.
bsb.6:54: Now these were the territories assigned to the descendants of Aaron from the Kohathite clan for their settlements, because the first lot fell to them:
bsb.6:55: They were given Hebron in the land of Judah and its surrounding pasturelands.
bsb.6:56: But the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
bsb.6:57: So the descendants of Aaron were given Hebron (a city of refuge), Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa,
bsb.6:59: Ashan, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh, together with their pasturelands.
bsb.6:60: And from the tribe of Benjamin they were given Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth, together with their pasturelands. So they had thirteen cities in all among their families.
bsb.6:61: To the rest of the Kohathites, ten cities were allotted from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
bsb.6:62: The Gershomites, according to their clans, were allotted thirteen cities from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan.
bsb.6:63: The Merarites, according to their families, were allotted twelve cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
bsb.6:64: So the Israelites gave to the Levites these cities and their pasturelands.
bsb.6:65: They assigned by lot the cities named above from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
bsb.6:66: And some of the clans of the Kohathites were given cities from the tribe of Ephraim for their territory:
bsb.6:67: They were given Shechem (a city of refuge) with its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, and Gezer,
bsb.6:69: Aijalon, and Gath-rimmon, together with their pasturelands.
bsb.6:70: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh the remaining clans of the Kohathites were given Aner and Bileam, together with their pasturelands.
bsb.6:71: The Gershomites received the following: From the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan and also Ashtaroth, together with their pasturelands.
bsb.6:72: From the tribe of Issachar they were given Kedesh, Daberath,
bsb.6:73: Ramoth, and Anem, together with their pasturelands.
bsb.6:74: From the tribe of Asher they were given Mashal, Abdon,
bsb.6:75: Hukok, and Rehob, together with their pasturelands.
bsb.6:76: And from the tribe of Naphtali they were given Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, together with their pasturelands.
bsb.6:77: The Merarites (the rest of the Levites) received the following: From the tribe of Zebulun they were given Rimmono and Tabor, together with their pasturelands.
bsb.6:78: From the tribe of Reuben east of the Jordan opposite Jericho they were given Bezer in the wilderness, Jahzah,
bsb.6:79: Kedemoth, and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands.
bsb.6:80: And from the tribe of Gad they were given Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim,
bsb.6:81: Heshbon, and Jazer, together with their pasturelands.
bsb.7:1: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron—four in all.
bsb.7:2: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, the heads of their families. In the days of David, 22,600 descendants of Tola were numbered in their genealogies as mighty men of valor.
bsb.7:3: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah:
bsb.7:4: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah. All five of them were chiefs. In addition to them, according to their genealogy, they had 36,000 troops for battle, for they had many wives and children.
bsb.7:5: Their kinsmen belonging to all the families of Issachar who were mighty men of valor totaled 87,000, as listed in their genealogies.
bsb.7:6: The three sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
bsb.7:7: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, heads of their families—five in all. There were 22,034 mighty men of valor listed in their genealogies.
bsb.7:9: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth; all these were Becher’s sons. Their genealogies were recorded according to the heads of their families—20,200 mighty men of valor.
bsb.7:10: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan:
bsb.7:11: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar. All these sons of Jediael were heads of their families, mighty men of valor; there were 17,200 fit for battle.
bsb.7:12: The Shuppites and Huppites were descendants of Ir, and the Hushites were descendants of Aher.
bsb.7:13: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum—the descendants of Bilhah.
bsb.7:14: The descendants of Manasseh: Through his Aramean concubine, Asriel, as well as Machir the father of Gilead.
bsb.7:15: Machir took a wife from among the Huppites and Shuppites. The name of his sister was Maacah. Another descendant was named Zelophehad, who had only daughters.
bsb.7:16: Machir’s wife Maacah gave birth to a son, and she named him Peresh. His brother was named Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rekem.
bsb.7:18: These were the sons of Gilead son of Machir, the son of Manasseh. His sister Hammolecheth gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
bsb.7:19: And these were the sons of Shemida: Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
bsb.7:21: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son, Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son. Ezer and Elead were killed by the natives of Gath, because they went down to steal their livestock.
bsb.7:22: Their father Ephraim mourned for many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.
bsb.7:23: And again he slept with his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. So he named him Beriah, because tragedy had come upon his house.
bsb.7:24: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth-horon, as well as Uzzen-sheerah.
bsb.7:25: Additionally, Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,
bsb.7:26: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
bsb.7:27: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.
bsb.7:28: Their holdings and settlements included Bethel and its villages, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its villages to the west, and Shechem and its villages as far as Ayyah and its villages.
bsb.7:29: And along the borders of Manasseh were Beth-shean, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, together with their villages. The descendants of Joseph son of Israel lived in these towns.
bsb.7:30: The children of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah.
bsb.7:31: The sons of Beriah: Heber, as well as Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
bsb.7:32: Heber was the father of Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and of their sister Shua.
bsb.7:33: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These were Japhlet’s sons.
bsb.7:34: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
bsb.7:35: The sons of his brother Helem: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
bsb.7:37: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah, Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
bsb.7:38: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
bsb.7:39: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
bsb.7:40: All these were the descendants of Asher—heads of their families, choice and mighty men of valor, and chiefs among the leaders. The number of men fit for battle, recorded in their genealogies, was 26,000.
bsb.8:1: Benjamin was the father of Bela, his firstborn; Ashbel was the second born, Aharah the third,
bsb.8:2: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
bsb.8:4: Addar, Gera, Abihud, Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
bsb.8:6: These were the descendants of Ehud who were the heads of the families living in Geba and were exiled to Manahath:
bsb.8:7: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them into exile and who was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
bsb.8:8: Shaharaim had sons in the country of Moab after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara.
bsb.8:9: His sons by his wife Hodesh:
bsb.8:10: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam, Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of families.
bsb.8:11: He also had sons by Hushim: Abitub and Elpaal.
bsb.8:13: Eber, Misham, Shemed (who built Ono and Lod with its villages), and Beriah and Shema (who were the heads of families of the inhabitants of Aijalon and who drove out the inhabitants of Gath).
bsb.8:16: Michael, Ishpah, and Joha were the sons of Beriah.
bsb.8:18: Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.
bsb.8:21: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.
bsb.8:25: Iphdeiah, and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.
bsb.8:27: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham.
bsb.8:28: All these were heads of families, the chiefs according to their genealogies, and they lived in Jerusalem.
bsb.8:29: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maacah,
bsb.8:30: and Abdon was his firstborn son, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
bsb.8:32: and Mikloth, who was the father of Shimeah. These also lived alongside their relatives in Jerusalem.
bsb.8:33: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
bsb.8:34: The son of Jonathan: Merib-baal, and Merib-baal was the father of Micah.
bsb.8:35: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
bsb.8:36: Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah, Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.
bsb.8:37: Moza was the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
bsb.8:38: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
bsb.8:39: The sons of his brother Eshek:
bsb.8:40: Ulam was his firstborn, Jeush second, and Eliphelet third. The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and they had many sons and grandsons—150 in all. All these were the descendants of Benjamin.
bsb.9:1: So all Israel was recorded in the genealogies written in the Book of the Kings of Israel. But Judah was exiled to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.
bsb.9:2: Now the first to resettle their own property in their cities were Israelites, priests, Levites, and temple servants.
bsb.9:3: These were some of the descendants of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh who lived in Jerusalem:
bsb.9:4: Uthai son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, a descendant of Perez son of Judah.
bsb.9:5: From the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
bsb.9:6: From the Zerahites: Jeuel and 690 relatives.
bsb.9:7: From the Benjamites: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;
bsb.9:8: Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; Meshullam son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
bsb.9:9: and 956 of their relatives according to their genealogy. All these men were heads of their families.
bsb.9:10: From the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, and Jachin;
bsb.9:11: Azariah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the chief official of God’s temple;
bsb.9:12: Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
bsb.9:13: and 1,760 of their relatives, the heads of their families, able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
bsb.9:14: From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, a descendant of Merari;
bsb.9:15: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
bsb.9:16: Obadiah son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
bsb.9:17: These were the gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives.
bsb.9:18: Shallum was their chief; he was previously stationed at the King’s Gate on the east side. These were the gatekeepers from the camp of the Levites.
bsb.9:19: Shallum son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his relatives from the Korahites were assigned to guard the thresholds of the Tent, just as their fathers had been assigned to guard the entrance to the dwelling of the LORD.
bsb.9:20: In earlier times Phinehas son of Eleazar had been in charge of the gatekeepers, and the LORD was with him.
bsb.9:21: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
bsb.9:22: The number of those chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds was 212. They were registered by genealogy in their villages. David and Samuel the seer had appointed them to their positions of trust.
bsb.9:23: So they and their descendants were assigned to guard the gates of the house of the LORD—the house called the Tent.
bsb.9:24: The gatekeepers were stationed on the four sides: east, west, north, and south.
bsb.9:25: Their relatives came from their villages at fixed times to serve with them for seven-day periods.
bsb.9:26: But the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted with the rooms and the treasuries of the house of God.
bsb.9:27: They would spend the night stationed around the house of God, because they were responsible for guarding it and opening it every morning.
bsb.9:28: Some of them were in charge of the articles used in worship, to count them whenever they were brought in or taken out.
bsb.9:29: Others were put in charge of the furnishings and other articles of the sanctuary, as well as the fine flour, wine, oil, frankincense, and spices.
bsb.9:30: And some of the sons of the priests mixed the spices.
bsb.9:31: A Levite named Mattithiah, the firstborn son of Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with baking the bread.
bsb.9:32: Some of their Kohathite brothers were responsible for preparing the rows of the showbread every Sabbath.
bsb.9:33: Those who were musicians, the heads of Levite families, stayed in the temple chambers and were exempt from other duties because they were on duty day and night.
bsb.9:34: All these were heads of Levite families, chiefs according to their genealogies, and they lived in Jerusalem.
bsb.9:35: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maacah.
bsb.9:36: Abdon was his firstborn son, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
bsb.9:38: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam. They too lived alongside their relatives in Jerusalem.
bsb.9:39: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
