asv.21:30: But David could not go before it to inquire of God; for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of Jehovah.
asv.22:1: Then David said, This is the house of Jehovah God, and this is the altar of burnt-offering for Israel.
asv.22:2: And David commanded to gather together the sojourners that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
asv.22:3: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the couplings; and brass in abundance without weight;
asv.22:4: and cedar-trees without number: for the Sidonians and they of Tyre brought cedar-trees in abundance to David.
asv.22:5: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for Jehovah must be exceeding magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.
asv.22:6: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build a house for Jehovah, the God of Israel.
asv.22:7: And David said to Solomon his son, As for me, it was in my heart to build a house unto the name of Jehovah my God.
asv.22:8: But the word of Jehovah came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build a house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
asv.22:9: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
asv.22:10: He shall build a house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
asv.22:11: Now, my son, Jehovah be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of Jehovah thy God, as he hath spoken concerning thee.
asv.22:12: Only Jehovah give thee discretion and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel; that so thou mayest keep the law of Jehovah thy God.
asv.22:13: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which Jehovah charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; fear not, neither be dismayed.
asv.22:14: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for the house of Jehovah a hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver, and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.
asv.22:15: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all men that are skilful in every manner of work:
asv.22:16: of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and Jehovah be with thee.
asv.22:17: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
asv.22:18: Is not Jehovah your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before Jehovah, and before his people.
asv.22:19: Now set your heart and your soul to seek after Jehovah your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of Jehovah God, to bring the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of Jehovah.
asv.23:1: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
asv.23:2: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
asv.23:3: And the Levites were numbered from thirty years old and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
asv.23:4: Of these, twenty and four thousand were to oversee the work of the house of Jehovah; and six thousand were officers and judges;
asv.23:5: and four thousand were doorkeepers; and four thousand praised Jehovah with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.
asv.23:6: And David divided them into courses according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
asv.23:7: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
asv.23:8: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
asv.23:9: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ houses of Ladan.
asv.23:10: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
asv.23:11: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.
asv.23:12: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
asv.23:13: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons, for ever, to burn incense before Jehovah, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, for ever.
asv.23:14: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
asv.23:15: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
asv.23:16: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
asv.23:17: And the sons of Eliezer were: Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
asv.23:18: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.
asv.23:19: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
asv.23:20: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.
asv.23:21: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
asv.23:22: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them to wife.
asv.23:23: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
asv.23:24: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those of them that were counted, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the house of Jehovah, from twenty years old and upward.
asv.23:25: For David said, Jehovah, the God of Israel, hath given rest unto his people; and he dwelleth in Jerusalem for ever:
asv.23:26: and also the Levites shall no more have need to carry the tabernacle and all the vessels of it for the service thereof.
asv.23:27: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were numbered, from twenty years old and upward.
asv.23:28: For their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of Jehovah, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of the house of God;
asv.23:29: for the showbread also, and for the fine flour for a meal-offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all manner of measure and size;
asv.23:30: and to stand every morning to thank and praise Jehovah, and likewise at even;
asv.23:31: and to offer all burnt-offerings unto Jehovah, on the sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before Jehovah;
asv.23:32: and that they should keep the charge of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, for the service of the house of Jehovah.
asv.24:1: And the courses of the sons of Aaron were these. The sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
asv.24:2: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.
asv.24:3: And David with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.
asv.24:4: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.
asv.24:5: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for there were princes of the sanctuary, and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
asv.24:6: And Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
asv.24:7: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
asv.24:8: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
asv.24:9: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
asv.24:10: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
asv.24:11: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
asv.24:12: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
asv.24:13: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
asv.24:14: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
asv.24:15: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
asv.24:16: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
asv.24:17: the one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
asv.24:18: the three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
asv.24:19: This was the ordering of them in their service, to come into the house of Jehovah according to the ordinance given unto them by Aaron their father, as Jehovah, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
asv.24:20: And of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
asv.24:21: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
asv.24:22: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
asv.24:23: And the sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
asv.24:24: The sons of Uzziel, Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
asv.24:25: The brother of Micah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
asv.24:26: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah: Beno.
asv.24:27: The sons of Merari: of Jaaziah, Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
asv.24:28: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
asv.24:29: Of Kish; the sons of Kish: Jerahmeel.
asv.24:30: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.
asv.24:31: These likewise cast lots even as their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the priests and of the Levites; the fathers’ houses of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
asv.25:1: Moreover David and the captains of the host set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of them that did the work according to their service was:
asv.25:2: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asharelah, the sons of Asaph, under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied after the order of the king.
asv.25:3: Of Jeduthun; the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun with the harp, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising Jehovah.
asv.25:4: Of Heman; the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth.
asv.25:5: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
asv.25:6: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of Jehovah, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God; Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.
asv.25:7: And the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in singing unto Jehovah, even all that were skilful, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
asv.25:8: And they cast lots for their offices, all alike, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
asv.25:9: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah; he and his brethren and sons were twelve:
asv.25:10: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:11: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:12: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:13: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:14: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:15: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:16: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:17: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:18: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:19: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:20: for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:21: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:22: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:23: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:24: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:25: for the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:26: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:27: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:28: for the one and twentieth to Hothir, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:29: for the two and twentieth to Giddalti, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:30: for the three and twentieth to Mahazioth, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
asv.25:31: for the four and twentieth to Romamtiezer, his sons and his brethren, twelve.
asv.26:1: For the courses of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
asv.26:2: And Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the first-born, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
asv.26:3: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Eliehoenai the seventh.
asv.26:4: And Obed-edom had sons: Shemaiah the first-born, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethanel the fifth,
asv.26:5: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.
asv.26:6: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.
asv.26:7: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
asv.26:8: All these were of the sons of Obed-edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men in strength for the service; threescore and two of Obed-edom.
asv.26:9: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, valiant men, eighteen.
asv.26:10: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the first-born, yet his father made him chief),
asv.26:11: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
asv.26:12: Of these were the courses of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brethren, to minister in the house of Jehovah.
asv.26:13: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.
asv.26:14: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a discreet counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
asv.26:15: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the store-house.
asv.26:16: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goeth up, watch against watch.
asv.26:17: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the store-house two and two.
asv.26:18: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
asv.26:19: These were the courses of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.
asv.26:20: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
asv.26:21: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ houses belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
asv.26:22: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the house of Jehovah.
asv.26:23: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:
asv.26:24: and Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasures.
asv.26:25: And his brethren: of Eliezer came Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.
asv.26:26: This Shelomoth and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ houses, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
asv.26:27: Out of the spoil won in battles did they dedicate to repair the house of Jehovah.
asv.26:28: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated, whosoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth, and of his brethren.
asv.26:29: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
asv.26:30: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valor, a thousand and seven hundred, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of Jehovah, and for the service of the king.
asv.26:31: Of the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ houses. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valor at Jazer of Gilead.
asv.26:32: And his brethren, men of valor, were two thousand and seven hundred, heads of fathers’ houses, whom king David made overseers over the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God, and for the affairs of the king.
asv.27:1: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the heads of fathers’ houses and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers that served the king, in any matter of the courses which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every course were twenty and four thousand.
asv.27:2: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
asv.27:3: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
asv.27:4: And over the course of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite, and his course; and Mikloth the ruler: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
asv.27:5: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the priest, chief: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
asv.27:6: This is that Benaiah, who was the mighty man of the thirty, and over the thirty: and of his course was Ammizabad his son.
asv.27:7: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
asv.27:8: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
asv.27:9: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
asv.27:10: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
asv.27:11: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
asv.27:12: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
asv.27:13: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
asv.27:14: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
asv.27:15: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
asv.27:16: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri the ruler: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah:
asv.27:17: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of Aaron, Zadok:
asv.27:18: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
asv.27:19: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel:
asv.27:20: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
asv.27:21: of the half- tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
asv.27:22: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.
asv.27:23: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under, because Jehovah had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of heaven.
asv.27:24: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but finished not; and there came wrath for this upon Israel; neither was the number put into the account in the chronicles of king David.
asv.27:25: And over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jonathan the son of Uzziah:
asv.27:26: and over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:
asv.27:27: and over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: and over the increase of the vineyards for the wine-cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
asv.27:28: and over the olive-trees and the sycomore-trees that were in the lowland was Baal-hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:
asv.27:29: and over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:
asv.27:30: and over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite: and over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.
asv.27:31: All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David’s.
asv.27:32: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counsellor, a man of understanding, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons:
asv.27:33: and Ahithophel was the king’s counsellor: and Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend:
asv.27:34: and after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the captain of the king’s host was Joab.
asv.28:1: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that served the king by course, and the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers, and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, unto Jerusalem.
asv.28:2: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: as for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and for the footstool of our God; and I had made ready for the building.
asv.28:3: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build a house for my name, because thou art a man of war, and hast shed blood.
asv.28:4: Howbeit Jehovah, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel;
asv.28:5: and of all my sons (for Jehovah hath given me many sons), he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of Jehovah over Israel.
asv.28:6: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
asv.28:7: And I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and mine ordinances, as at this day.
asv.28:8: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, the assembly of Jehovah, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of Jehovah your God; that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you for ever.
asv.28:9: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for Jehovah searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts. If thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
asv.28:10: Take heed now; for Jehovah hath chosen thee to build a house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.
asv.28:11: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch of the temple, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper rooms thereof, and of the inner chambers thereof, and of the place of the mercy-seat;
asv.28:12: and the pattern of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of the house of Jehovah, and for all the chambers round about, for the treasuries of the house of God, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;
asv.28:13: also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of Jehovah, and for all the vessels of service in the house of Jehovah;
asv.28:14: of gold by weight for the vessels of gold, for all vessels of every kind of service; of silver for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;
asv.28:15: by weight also for the candlesticks of gold, and for the lamps thereof, of gold, by weight for every candlestick and for the lamps thereof; and for the candlesticks of silver, silver by weight for every candlestick and for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick;
asv.28:16: and the gold by weight for the tables of showbread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;
asv.28:17: and the flesh-hooks, and the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;
asv.28:18: and for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot, even the cherubim, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of Jehovah.
asv.28:19: All this, said David, have I been made to understand in writing from the hand of Jehovah, even all the works of this pattern.
asv.28:20: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed; for Jehovah God, even my God, is with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until all the work for the service of the house of Jehovah be finished.
asv.28:21: And, behold, there are the courses of the priests and the Levites, for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee in all manner of work every willing man that hath skill, for any manner of service: also the captains and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.
asv.29:1: And David the king said unto all the assembly, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for Jehovah God.
asv.29:2: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, and the silver for the things of silver, and the brass for the things of brass, the iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, stones for inlaid work, and of divers colors, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
asv.29:3: Moreover also, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, seeing that I have a treasure of mine own of gold and silver, I give it unto the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
asv.29:4: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, wherewith to overlay the walls of the houses;
asv.29:5: of gold for the things of gold, and of silver for the things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. Who then offereth willingly to consecrate himself this day unto Jehovah?
asv.29:6: Then the princes of the fathers’ houses, and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king’s work, offered willingly;
asv.29:7: and they gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and of iron a hundred thousand talents.
asv.29:8: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of Jehovah, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
asv.29:9: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to Jehovah: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
asv.29:10: Wherefore David blessed Jehovah before all the assembly; and David said, Blessed be thou, O Jehovah, the God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.
asv.29:11: Thine, O Jehovah, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heavens and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O Jehovah, and thou art exalted as head above all.
asv.29:12: Both riches and honor come of thee, and thou rulest over all; and in thy hand is power and might; and in thy hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.
asv.29:13: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
asv.29:14: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.
asv.29:15: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as all our fathers were: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no abiding.
asv.29:16: O Jehovah our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee a house for thy holy name cometh of thy hand, and is all thine own.
asv.29:17: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, that are present here, offer willingly unto thee.
asv.29:18: O Jehovah, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee;
asv.29:19: and give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.
asv.29:20: And David said to all the assembly, Now bless Jehovah your God. And all the assembly blessed Jehovah, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped Jehovah, and the king.
asv.29:21: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto Jehovah, and offered burnt-offerings unto Jehovah, on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink-offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,
asv.29:22: and did eat and drink before Jehovah on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto Jehovah to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.
asv.29:23: Then Solomon sat on the throne of Jehovah as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
asv.29:24: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.
asv.29:25: And Jehovah magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
asv.29:26: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
asv.29:27: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
asv.29:28: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
asv.29:29: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,
asv.29:30: with all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.

ylt.1:5: Sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
ylt.1:6: And sons of Gomer: Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
ylt.1:7: And sons of Javan: Elisha, and Tarshishah, Kittim, and Dodanim.
ylt.1:8: Sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
ylt.1:9: And sons of Cush: Seba and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecka. And sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
ylt.1:10: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the land.
ylt.1:11: And Mizraim begat the Ludim, and the Anamim, and the Lehabim, and the Naphtuhim,
ylt.1:12: and the Pathrusim, and the Casluhim (from whom came out the Philistim), and the Caphtorim.
ylt.1:13: And Canaan begat Zidon his first born, and Heth,
ylt.1:14: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
ylt.1:15: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
ylt.1:16: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
ylt.1:17: Sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
ylt.1:18: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.
ylt.1:19: And to Eber have been born two sons, the name of the one is Peleg, for in his days hath the land been divided, and the name of his brother is Joktan.
ylt.1:20: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
ylt.1:21: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
ylt.1:22: and Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
ylt.1:23: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab; all these are sons of Joktan.
ylt.1:28: Sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
ylt.1:29: These are their generations: first-born of Ishmael, Nebaioth, and Kedar, and Adheel, and Mibsam,
ylt.1:30: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
ylt.1:31: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedema. These are sons of Ishmael.
ylt.1:32: And sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
ylt.1:33: And sons of Midian: Ephah and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah; all these are sons of Keturah.
ylt.1:34: And Abraham begetteth Isaac. Sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
ylt.1:35: Sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
ylt.1:36: Sons of Eliphaz: Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
ylt.1:37: Sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
ylt.1:38: And sons of Seir: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezar, and Dishan.
ylt.1:39: And sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam, and sister of Lotan is Timna.
ylt.1:40: Sons of Shobal: Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And sons of Zideon: Aiah and Anah.
ylt.1:41: The sons of Anah: Dishon. and sons of Dishon: Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
ylt.1:42: Sons of Ezer: Bilhan, and Zavan, Jakan. Sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
ylt.1:43: And these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before the reigning of a king of the sons of Israel: Bela son of Beor, and the name of his city is Dinhabah.
ylt.1:44: And Bela dieth, and reign in his stead doth Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrali;
ylt.1:45: and Jobab dieth, and reign in his stead doth Husham from the land of the Temanite;
ylt.1:46: and Husham dieth, and reign in his stead doth Hadad, son of Bedad (who smiteth Midian in the field of Moab) and the name of his city is Avith;
ylt.1:47: and Hadad dieth, and reign in his stead doth Samlah from Masrekah;
ylt.1:48: and Samlah dieth, and reign in his stead doth Shaul from Rehoboth of the River;
ylt.1:49: and Shaul dieth, and reign in his stead doth Baal-Hanan son of Achbor;
ylt.1:50: and Baal-Hanan dieth, and reign in his stead doth Hadad, and the name of his city is Pai, and the name of his wife is Mehetabel daughter of Matred, daughter of Me-Zahab; Hadad also dieth.
ylt.1:51: And chiefs of Edom are: chief Timnah, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
ylt.1:52: chief Aholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
ylt.1:53: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
ylt.1:54: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These are chiefs of Edom.
ylt.2:1: These are sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
ylt.2:2: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
ylt.2:3: Sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah, three have been born to him of a daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, first-born of Judah, is evil in the eyes of Jehovah, and He putteth him to death.
ylt.2:4: And Tamar his daughter-in-law hath borne to him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah are five.
ylt.2:5: Sons of Pharez: Hezron, and Hamul.
ylt.2:6: And sons of Zerah: Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara; all of them five.
ylt.2:7: And sons of Carmi: Achar, troubler of Israel, who trespassed in the devoted thing.
ylt.2:9: And sons of Hezron who were born to him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
ylt.2:10: And Ram begat Amminadab, and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the sons of Judah;
ylt.2:11: and Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
ylt.2:12: and Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse;
ylt.2:13: and Jesse begat his first-born Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,
ylt.2:14: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
ylt.2:15: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh,
ylt.2:16: and their sisters Zeruiah and Abigail. And sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, and Joab, and Asah-El--three.
ylt.2:17: And Abigail hath borne Amasa, and the father of Amasa is Jether the Ishmeelite.
ylt.2:18: And Caleb son of Hezron hath begotten Azubah, Isshah, and Jerioth; and these are her sons: Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
ylt.2:19: And Azubah dieth, and Caleb taketh to him Ephrath, and she beareth to him Hur.
ylt.2:20: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
ylt.2:21: And afterwards hath Hezron gone in unto a daughter of Machir father of Gilead, and he hath taken her, and he is a son of sixty years, and she beareth to him Segub.
ylt.2:22: And Segub begat Jair, and he hath twenty and three cities in the land of Gilead,
ylt.2:23: and he taketh Geshur and Aram, the small villages of Jair, from them, with Kenath and its small towns, sixty cities--all these belonged to the sons of Machir father of Gilead.
ylt.2:24: And after the death of Hezron in Caleb-Ephratah, then the wife of Hezron, Abijah, even beareth to him Asshur, father of Tekoa.
ylt.2:25: And sons of Jerahmeel, first-born of Hezron, are: the first-born Ram, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, Ahijah.
ylt.2:26: And Jerahmeel hath another wife, and her name is Atarah, she is mother of Onam.
ylt.2:27: And sons of Ram, first-born of Jerahmeel, are Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
ylt.2:28: And sons of Onam are Shammai and Jada. And sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
ylt.2:29: And the name of the wife of Abishur is Abihail, and she beareth to him Ahban and Molid.
ylt.2:30: And sons of Nadab: Seled, and Appaim; and Seled dieth without sons.
ylt.2:31: And sons of Appaim: Ishi. And sons of Ishi: Sheshan. And sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.
ylt.2:32: And sons of Jada, brother of Shammai: Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether dieth without sons.
ylt.2:33: And sons of Jonathan: Peleth, and Zaza. These were sons of Jerahmeel.
ylt.2:34: And Sheshan had no sons, but daughters, and Sheshan hath a servant, an Egyptian, and his name is Jarha,
ylt.2:35: and Sheshan giveth his daughter to Jarha his servant for a wife, and she beareth to him Attai;
ylt.2:36: and Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
ylt.2:37: and Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
ylt.2:39: and Jehu begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
ylt.2:40: and Eleasah begat Sismai, and Sismai begat Shallum,
ylt.2:41: and Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
ylt.2:42: And sons of Caleb brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his first-born, he is father of Ziph; and sons of Mareshah: Abi-Hebron.
ylt.2:43: And sons of Hebron: Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
ylt.2:44: And Shema begat Raham father of Jorkoam, and Rekem begat Shammai.
ylt.2:45: And a son of Shammai is Maon, and Maon is father of Beth-Zur.
ylt.2:46: And Ephah concubine of Caleb bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez; and Haran begat Gazez.
ylt.2:47: And sons of Jahdai: Regem, and Jotham, and Geshem, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
ylt.2:48: The concubine of Caleb, Maachah, bare Sheber and Tirhanah;
ylt.2:49: and she beareth Shaaph father of Madmannah, Sheva father of Machbenah, and father of Gibea; and a daughter of Caleb is Achsa.
ylt.2:50: These were sons of Caleb son of Hur, first-born of Ephrathah: Shobal father of Kirjath-Jearim,
ylt.2:51: Salma father of Beth-Lehem, Hareph father of Beth-Gader.
ylt.2:52: And there are sons to Shobal father of Kirjath-Jearim: Haroeh, half of the Menuhothite;
ylt.2:53: and the families of Kirjath-Jearim: the Ithrite, and the Puhite, and the Shumathite, and the Mishraite: from these went out the Zareathite, and the Eshtaulite.
ylt.2:54: Sons of Salma: Beth-Lehem, and the Netophathite, Atroth, Beth-Joab, and half of the Menuhothite, the Zorite;
ylt.2:55: and the families of the scribes the inhabitants of Jabez: Tirathites, Shimeathites, Suchathites. They are the Kenites, those coming of Hammath father of the house of Rechab.
ylt.3:1: And these were sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the first-born Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;
ylt.3:2: the third Absalom, son of Maachah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth Adonijah, son of Haggith;
ylt.3:3: the fifth Shephatiah, of Abital; the sixth Ithream, of Eglah his wife.
ylt.3:4: Six have been borne to him in Hebron, and he reigneth there seven years and six months, and thirty and three years he hath reigned in Jerusalem.
ylt.3:5: And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon--four, of Bath-Sheba daughter of Ammiel:
ylt.3:6: also Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
ylt.3:7: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
ylt.3:8: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
ylt.3:9: All are sons of David, apart from sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
ylt.3:10: And the son of Solomon is Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
ylt.3:11: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
ylt.3:12: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
ylt.3:13: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
ylt.3:14: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
ylt.3:15: And sons of Josiah: the first-born Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
ylt.3:16: And sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
ylt.3:17: And sons of Jeconiah: Assir; Salathiel his son;
ylt.3:18: also Malchiram and Pedaiah, and Shenazzar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
ylt.3:19: And sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel, and Shimei. And sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister,
ylt.3:20: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-Hesed, five.
ylt.3:21: And sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah, and Jesaiah, sons of Rephaiah, sons of Arnan, sons of Obadiah, sons of Shechaniah.
ylt.3:22: And sons of Shechaniah: Shemaiah; and sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
ylt.3:23: And sons of Neariah: Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
ylt.3:24: And sons of Elioenai: Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
ylt.4:1: Sons of Judah: Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
ylt.4:2: And Reaiah son of Shobal begat Jahath, and Jahath begat Ahumai and Lahad; these are families of the Zorathite.
ylt.4:3: And these are of the father of Etam: Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister is Hazzelelponi,
ylt.4:4: and Penuel is father of Gedor, and Ezer father of Hushah. These are sons of Hur, first-born of Ephratah, father of Beth-Lehem.
ylt.4:5: And to Ashhur father of Tekoa were two wives, Helah and Naarah;
ylt.4:6: and Naarah beareth to him Ahuzzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari: these are sons of Naarah.
ylt.4:7: And sons of Helah: Zereth, and Zohar, and Ethnan.
ylt.4:8: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel son of Harum.
ylt.4:9: And Jabez is honoured above his brethren, and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, `Because I have brought forth with grief.'
ylt.4:10: And Jabez calleth to the God of Israel, saying, `If blessing Thou dost bless me, then Thou hast made great my border, and Thy hand hath been with me, and Thou hast kept me from evil--not to grieve me;' and God bringeth in that which he asked.
ylt.4:11: And Chelub brother of Shuah begat Mehir; he is father of Eshton.
ylt.4:12: And Eshton begat Beth-Rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah father of Ir-Nahash; these are men of Rechah.
ylt.4:13: And sons of Kenaz: Othniel, and Seraiah; and sons of Othniel: Hathath.
ylt.4:14: And Meonothai begat Ophrah, and Seraiah begat Joab father of the valley of artificers, for they were artificers.
ylt.4:15: And sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
ylt.4:16: And sons of Jehaleleel: Ziph and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
ylt.4:17: And sons of Ezra are Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she beareth Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah father of Eshtemoa.
ylt.4:18: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered father of Gedor, and Heber father of Socho, and Jekuthiel father of Zanoah. And these are sons of Bithiah daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took,
ylt.4:19: and sons of the wife of Hodiah sister of Nahom: Abi-Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
ylt.4:20: And sons of Shimon are Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-Hanon, and Tilon; and sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben-Zoheth.
ylt.4:21: Sons of Shelah son of Judah: Er father of Lecah, and Laadah father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of the service of fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;
ylt.4:22: and Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who ruled over Moab and Jashubi-Lehem; and these things are ancient.
ylt.4:23: They are the potters and inhabitants of Netaim and Gedera; with the king in his work they dwelt there.
ylt.4:24: Sons of Simeon: Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
ylt.4:25: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
ylt.4:26: And sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.
ylt.4:27: And to Shimei are sixteen sons and six daughters, and to his brethren there are not many sons, and none of their families have multiplied as much as the sons of Judah.
ylt.4:28: And they dwell in Beer-Sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-Shaul,
ylt.4:29: and in Bilhah, and in Ezem, and in Tolad,
ylt.4:30: and in Bethuel, and in Hormah, and in Ziklag,
ylt.4:31: and in Beth-Marcaboth, and in Hazar-Susim, and in Beth-Birei, and in Shaarim; these are their cities till the reigning of David.
ylt.4:32: And their villages are Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities,
ylt.4:33: and all their villages that are round about these cities unto Baal; these are their dwellings, and they have their genealogy:
ylt.4:34: even Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah son of Amaziah,
ylt.4:35: and Joel, and Jehu son of Josibiah, son of Seraiah, son of Asiel,
ylt.4:36: and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
ylt.4:37: and Ziza son of Shiphi, son of Allon, son of Jedaiah, son of Shimri, son of Shemaiah.
ylt.4:38: These who are coming in by name are princes in their families, and the house of their fathers have broken forth into a multitude;
ylt.4:39: and they go to the entrance of Gedor, unto the east of the valley, to seek pasture for their flock,
ylt.4:40: and they find pasture, fat and good, and the land broad of sides, and quiet, and safe, for of Ham are those dwelling there before.
ylt.4:41: And these who are written by name come in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smite their tents, and the habitations that have been found there, and devote them to destruction unto this day, and dwell in their stead, because pasture for their flock is there.
ylt.4:42: And of them, of the sons of Simeon, there have gone to mount Seir, five hundred men, and Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, sons of Ishi, at their head,
ylt.4:43: and they smite the remnant of those escaped of Amalek, and dwell there unto this day.
ylt.5:1: As to sons of Reuben, first-born of Israel--for he is the first-born, and on account of his profaning the couch of his father hath his birthright been given to the sons of Joseph son of Israel, and he is not to be reckoned by genealogy for the birthright,
ylt.5:2: for Judah hath been mighty over his brother, and for leader above him, and the birthright is to Joseph.
ylt.5:3: Sons of Reuben, first-born of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
ylt.5:4: Sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
ylt.5:5: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
ylt.5:6: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-Pilneser king of Asshur removed; he is prince of the Reubenite.
ylt.5:7: And his brethren, by their families, in the genealogy of their generations, are heads: Jeiel, and Zechariah,
ylt.5:8: and Bela son of Azaz, son of Shema, son of Joel--he is dwelling in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-Meon;
ylt.5:9: and at the east he dwelt even unto the entering in of the wilderness, even from the river Phrat, for their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
ylt.5:10: And in the days of Saul they have made war with the Hagarites, who fall by their hand, and they dwell in their tents over all the face of the east of Gilead.
ylt.5:11: And the sons of Gad, over-against them have dwelt in the land of Bashan unto Salcah,
ylt.5:12: Joel the head, and Shapham the second, and Jaanai and Shaphat in Bashan;
ylt.5:13: and their brethren of the house of their fathers are Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.
ylt.5:14: These are sons of Abihail son of Huri, son of Jaroah, son of Gilead, son of Michael, son of Jeshishai, son of Jahdo, son of Buz;
ylt.5:15: Ahi son of Abdiel, son of Guni, is head of the house of their fathers;
ylt.5:16: and they dwell in Gilead in Bashan, and in her small towns, and in all suburbs of Sharon, upon their outskirts;
ylt.5:17: all of them reckoned themselves by genealogy in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
ylt.5:18: Sons of Reuben, and the Gadite, and the half of the tribe of Manasseh, of sons of valour, men bearing shield and sword, and treading bow, and taught in battle, are forty and four thousand and seven hundred and sixty, going out to the host.
ylt.5:19: And they make war with the Hagarites, and Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab,
ylt.5:20: and they are helped against them, and the Hagarites are given into their hand, and all who are with them, for they cried to God in battle, and He was entreated of them, because they trusted in Him.
ylt.5:21: And they take captive their cattle, of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of human beings a hundred thousand;
ylt.5:22: for many have fallen pierced, for of God is the battle; and they dwell in their stead till the removal.
ylt.5:23: And the sons of the half of the tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land, from Bashan unto Baal-Hermon, and Senir, and mount Hermon, they have multiplied.
ylt.5:24: And these are heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, men mighty in valour, men of name, heads to the house of their fathers.
ylt.5:25: And they trespass against the God of their fathers, and go a-whoring after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed from their presence;
ylt.5:26: and stir up doth the God of Israel the spirit of Pul king of Asshur, and the spirit of Tilgath-Pilneser king of Asshur, and he removeth them--even the Reubenite, and the Gadite, and the half of the tribe of Manasseh--and bringeth them in to Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and the river of Gozan unto this day.
ylt.6:1: Sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
ylt.6:2: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
ylt.6:3: And sons of Amram: Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. And sons of Aaron: Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
ylt.6:4: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
ylt.6:5: and Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
ylt.6:6: and Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
ylt.6:7: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
ylt.6:8: and Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
ylt.6:9: and Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
ylt.6:10: and Johanan begat Azariah, him who acted as priest in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
ylt.6:11: And Azariah begetteth Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
ylt.6:12: and Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
ylt.6:13: and Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
ylt.6:14: and Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak;
ylt.6:15: and Jehozadak hath gone in Jehovah's removing Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
ylt.6:16: Sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
ylt.6:17: And these are names of sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
ylt.6:18: And sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
ylt.6:19: Sons of Merari; Mahli and Mushi. And these are families of the Levite according to their fathers;
ylt.6:20: of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
ylt.6:21: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
ylt.6:22: Sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
ylt.6:23: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
ylt.6:24: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
ylt.6:25: And sons of Elkanah; Amasai and Ahimoth.
ylt.6:26: Elkanah; sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
ylt.6:27: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
ylt.6:28: And sons of Samuel: the first-born Vashni, and the second Abijah.
ylt.6:29: Sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
ylt.6:30: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
ylt.6:31: And these are they whom David stationed over the parts of the song of the house of Jehovah, from the resting of the ark,
ylt.6:32: and they are ministering before the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, in song, till the building by Solomon of the house of Jehovah in Jerusalem; and they stand according to their ordinance over their service.
ylt.6:33: And these are those standing, and their sons: of the sons of the Kohathite: Heman the singer, son of Joel, son of Shemuel,
ylt.6:34: son of Elkanah, son of Jeroham, son of Eliel, son of Toah,
ylt.6:35: son of Zuph, son of Elkanah, son of Mahath, son of Amasai,
ylt.6:36: son of Elkanah, son of Joel, son of Azariah, son of Zephaniah,
ylt.6:37: son of Tahath, son of Assir, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah,
ylt.6:38: son of Izhar, son of Kohath, son of Levi, son of Israel.
ylt.6:39: And his brother Asaph, who is standing on his right--Asaph, son of Berachiah, son of Shimea,
ylt.6:40: son of Michael, son of Baaseiah, son of Malchiah,
ylt.6:41: son of Ethni, son of Zerah, son of Adaiah,
ylt.6:42: son of Ethan, son of Zimmah, son of Shimei,
ylt.6:43: son of Jahath, son of Gershom, son of Levi.
ylt.6:44: And sons of Merari, their brethren, are on the left. Ethan son of Kishi, son of Abdi, son of Malluch,
ylt.6:45: son of Hashabiah, son of Amaziah, son of Hilkiah,
ylt.6:46: son of Amzi, son of Bani, son of Shamer,
ylt.6:47: son of Mahli, son of Mushi, son of Merari, son of Levi.
ylt.6:48: And their brethren the Levites are put to all the service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
ylt.6:49: And Aaron and his sons are making perfume on the altar of the burnt-offering, and on the altar of the perfume, for all the work of the holy of holies, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses servant of God commanded.
ylt.6:50: And these are sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
ylt.6:51: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
ylt.6:52: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
ylt.6:53: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
ylt.6:54: And these are their dwellings, throughout their towers, in their borders, of the sons of Aaron, of the family of the Kohathite, for theirs was the lot;
ylt.6:55: and they give to them Hebron in the land of Judah and its suburbs round about it;
ylt.6:56: and the field of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
ylt.6:57: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge: Hebron, and Libnah and its suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa and its suburbs,
ylt.6:58: and Hilen and its suburbs, Debir and its suburbs,
ylt.6:59: and Ashan and its suburbs, and Beth-Shemesh and its suburbs.
ylt.6:60: And from the tribe of Benjamin, Geba and its suburbs, and Allemeth and its suburbs, and Anathoth and its suburbs. All their cities are thirteen cities, for their families.
ylt.6:61: And to the sons of Kohath, those left of the family of the tribe, from the half of the tribe, the half of Manasseh, by lot, are ten cities.
ylt.6:62: And to the sons of Gershom, for their families, from the tribe of Issachar, and from the tribe of Asher, and from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
ylt.6:63: To the sons of Merari, for their families, from the tribe of Reuben, and from the tribe of Gad, and from the tribe of Zebulun, by lot, twelve cities.
ylt.6:64: And the sons of Israel give to the Levites the cities and their suburbs.
ylt.6:65: And they give by lot from the tribe of the sons of Judah, and from the tribe of the sons of Simeon, and from the tribe of the sons of Benjamin, these cities which they call by name;
ylt.6:66: and some of the families of the sons of Kohath have cities of their border from the tribe of Ephraim;
ylt.6:67: and they give to them the cities of refuge, Shechem and its suburbs in the hill-country of Ephraim, and Gezer and its suburbs,
ylt.6:68: and Jokmeam and its suburbs, and Beth-Horan and its suburbs,
ylt.6:69: and Aijalon and its suburbs, and Gath-Rimmon and its suburbs;
ylt.6:70: and from the half tribe of Manasseh, Aner and its suburbs, and Bileam and its suburbs, for the family of the sons of Kohath who are left.
ylt.6:71: To the sons of Gershom from the family of the half of the tribe of Manasseh are Golan in Bashan and its suburbs, and Ashtaroth and its suburbs;
ylt.6:72: and from the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh and its suburbs, Daberath and its suburbs,
ylt.6:73: and Ramoth and its suburbs, and Anem and its suburbs;
ylt.6:74: and from the tribe of Asher; Mashal and its suburbs, and Abdon and its suburbs,
ylt.6:75: and Hukok and its suburbs, and Rehob and its suburbs;
ylt.6:76: and from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee and its suburbs, and Hammon and its suburbs, and Kirjathaim and its suburbs.
ylt.6:77: To the sons of Merari who are left, from the tribe of Zebulun, are Rimmon and its suburbs, Tabor and its suburbs;
ylt.6:78: and from beyond the Jordan by Jericho, at the east of the Jordan, from the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness and its suburbs, and Jahzah and its suburbs,
ylt.6:79: and Kedemoth and its suburbs, and Mephaath and its suburbs;
ylt.6:80: and from the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead and its suburbs, and Mahanaim and its suburbs,
ylt.6:81: and Heshbon and its suburbs, and Jazer and its suburbs.
ylt.7:1: And sons of Issachar; Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
ylt.7:2: And sons of Tola: Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of the house of their fathers, even of Tola, mighty of valour in their generations: their number in the days of David is twenty and two thousand and six hundred.
ylt.7:3: And sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah; and sons of Izrahiah: Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, Hamishah--all of them heads.
ylt.7:4: And beside them, by their generations, of the house of their fathers, are troops of the host of battle, thirty and six thousand, for they multiplied wives and sons;
ylt.7:5: and their brethren of all the families of Issachar are mighty of valour, eighty and seven thousand, all have their genealogy.
ylt.7:6: Of Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
ylt.7:7: And sons of Bela: Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of a house of fathers, mighty of valour, with their genealogy, twenty and two thousand, and thirty and four.
ylt.7:8: And sons of Becher: Zemirah, and Joash, and Eliezar, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abijah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are sons of Becher,
ylt.7:9: with their genealogy, after their generations, heads of a house of their fathers, mighty of valour, twenty thousand and two hundred.
ylt.7:10: And sons of Jediael: Bilhan; and sons of Bilhan: Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
ylt.7:11: All these are sons of Jediael, even heads of the fathers, mighty in valour, seventeen thousand and two hundred going out to the host for battle.
ylt.7:12: And Shuppim and Huppim are sons of Ir; Hushim son of Aher.
ylt.7:13: Sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, sons of Bilhah.
ylt.7:14: Sons of Manasseh: Ashriel, whom Jaladah his Aramaean concubine bare, with Machir father of Gilead.
ylt.7:15: And Machir took wives for Huppim and for Shuppim, and the name of the one is Maachah, and the name of the second Zelophehad, and Zelophehad hath daughters.
ylt.7:16: And Maachah wife of Machir beareth a son and calleth his name Peresh, and the name of his brother is Sheresh, and his sons are Ulam and Rakem.
ylt.7:17: And son of Ulam: Bedan. These are sons of Gilead son of Machir, son of Manasseh.
ylt.7:18: And his sister Hammolecheth bare Ishhod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
ylt.7:19: And the sons of Shemida are Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
ylt.7:20: And sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
ylt.7:21: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead; and slain them have men of Gath who are born in the land, because they came down to take their cattle.
ylt.7:22: And Ephraim their father mourneth many days, and his brethren come in to comfort him,
ylt.7:23: and he goeth in unto his wife, and she conceiveth and beareth a son, and he calleth his name Beriah, because in evil had been his house, --
ylt.7:24: and his daughter is Sherah, and she buildeth Beth-Horon, the lower and the upper, and Uzzen-Sherah--
ylt.7:25: and Rephah is his son, and Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
ylt.7:26: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
ylt.7:27: Non his son, Jehoshua his son.
ylt.7:28: And their possession and their dwellings are Beth-El and its small towns, and to the east Naaran, and to the west Gezer and its small towns, and Shechem and its small towns, unto Gaza and its small towns;
ylt.7:29: and by the parts of the sons of Manasseh, Beth-Shean and its small towns, Taanach and its small towns, Megiddo and its small towns, Dor and its small towns; in these dwelt the sons of Joseph son of Israel.
ylt.7:30: Son of Asher: Imnah, and Ishve, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
ylt.7:31: And sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel--he is father of Birzavith.
ylt.7:32: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
ylt.7:33: And sons of Japhlet: Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath; these are sons of Japhlet.
ylt.7:34: and sons of Shamer: Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
ylt.7:35: And son of Helem his brother: Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
ylt.7:36: Sons of Zophah: Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
ylt.7:37: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
ylt.7:38: And sons of Jether: Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
ylt.7:39: And sons of Ulla: Arah, and Hanniel, and Rezia.
ylt.7:40: All these are sons of Asher, heads of the house of the fathers, chosen ones, mighty in valour, heads of the princes, with their genealogy, for the host, for battle, their number is twenty and six thousand men.
ylt.8:1: And Benjamin begat Bela his first-born, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
ylt.8:2: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
ylt.8:3: And there are sons to Bela: Addar, and Gera,
ylt.8:4: and Abihud, and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
ylt.8:5: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
ylt.8:6: And these are sons of Ehud: they are heads of fathers to the inhabitants of Geba, and they remove them unto Manahath;
ylt.8:7: and Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza and Ahihud.
ylt.8:8: And Shaharaim begat in the field of Moab, after his sending them away; Hushim and Baara are his wives.
ylt.8:9: And he begetteth of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
ylt.8:10: and Jeuz, and Shachiah, and Mirmah. These are his sons, heads of fathers.
ylt.8:11: And of Hushim he begat Ahitub and Elpaal.
ylt.8:12: And sons of Elpaal: Eber, and Misheam, and Shamer, (he built Ono and Lod and its small towns),
ylt.8:13: and Beriah and Shema, (they are the heads of fathers to the inhabitants of Aijalon--they caused to flee the inhabitants of Gath),
ylt.8:15: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,
ylt.8:16: and Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, sons of Beriah,
ylt.8:17: and Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
ylt.8:18: and Ishmerai, and Jezliah, and Jobab, sons of Elpaal;
ylt.8:19: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
ylt.8:20: and Elienai, and Zillethai, and Eliel,
ylt.8:21: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, sons of Shimei;
ylt.8:22: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
ylt.8:23: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
ylt.8:24: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
ylt.8:25: and Iphedeiah, and Penuel, sons of Shashak;
ylt.8:26: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
ylt.8:27: and Jaareshiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, sons of Jeroham.
ylt.8:28: These are heads of fathers, by their generations, heads; these dwelt in Jerusalem.
ylt.8:29: And in Gibeon hath the father of Gibeon dwelt, and the name of his wife is Maachah;
ylt.8:30: and his son, the first-born, is Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
ylt.8:31: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher;
ylt.8:32: and Mikloth begat Shimeah. And they also over-against their brethren dwelt in Jerusalem with their brethren.
ylt.8:33: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-Shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-Baal.
ylt.8:34: And a son of Jonathan is Merib-Baal, and Merib-Baal begat Micah;
ylt.8:35: and sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz:
ylt.8:36: and Ahaz begat Jehoadah, and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
ylt.8:37: and Moza begat Binea, Raphah is his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
ylt.8:38: And to Azel are six sons, and these are their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these are sons of Azel.
ylt.8:39: And sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his first-born, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
ylt.8:40: And the sons of Ulam are men mighty in valour, treading bow, and multiplying sons and son's sons, a hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
ylt.9:1: And all Israel have reckoned themselves by genealogy, and lo, they are written on the book of the kings of Israel and Judah--they were removed to Babylon for their trespass.
ylt.9:2: And the first inhabitants, who are in their possession, in their cities, of Israel, are the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinim.
ylt.9:3: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the sons of Judah, and of the sons of Benjamin, and of the sons of Ephraim and Manasseh:
ylt.9:4: Uthai son of Ammihud, son of Omri, son of Imri, son of Bani, of the sons of Pharez, son of Judah.
ylt.9:5: And of the Shilonite: Asaiah the first-born, and his sons.
ylt.9:6: And of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
ylt.9:7: And of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Hodaviah, son of Hassenuah,
ylt.9:8: and Ibneiah son of Jeroham, and Elah son of Uzzi, son of Michri, and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, son of Reuel, son of Ibnijah.
ylt.9:9: And their brethren, according to their generations, are nine hundred and fifty and six. All these are men, heads of fathers, according to the house of their fathers.
ylt.9:10: And of the priests: Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
ylt.9:11: and Azariah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub, leader in the house of God;
ylt.9:12: and Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pashhur, son of Malchijah, and Maasai son of Adiel, son of Jahzerah, son of Meshullam, son of Meshillemith, son of Immer.
ylt.9:13: And their brethren, heads to the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and sixty, mighty in valour, are for the work of the service of the house of God.
ylt.9:14: And of the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hashshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
ylt.9:15: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah son of Micah, son of Zichri, son of Asaph;
ylt.9:16: and Obadiah son of Shemariah, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah, son of Asa, son of Elkanah, who is dwelling in the villages of the Netophathite.
ylt.9:17: And the gatekeepers are Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren--Shallum is the head;
ylt.9:18: and hitherto they are at the gate of the king eastward; they are the gatekeepers for the companies of the sons of Levi.
ylt.9:19: And Shallum son of Kore, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, are over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent, and their fathers are over the camp of Jehovah, keepers of the entrance;
ylt.9:20: and Phinehas son of Eleazar hath been leader over them formerly; Jehovah is with him.
ylt.9:21: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah is gatekeeper at the opening of the tent of meeting.
ylt.9:22: All of those who are chosen for gatekeepers at the thresholds are two hundred and twelve; they are in their villages, by their genealogy; they whom David and Samuel the seer appointed in their office.
ylt.9:23: And they and their sons are over the gates of the house of Jehovah, even of the house of the tent, by watches.
ylt.9:24: At four sides are the gatekeepers, east, west, north, and south.
ylt.9:25: And their brethren in their villages are to come in for seven days from time to time with these.
ylt.9:26: For in office are the four chiefs of the gatekeepers, they are Levites, and they have been over the chambers, and over the treasuries of the house of God,
ylt.9:27: and round about the house of God they lodge, for on them is the watch, and they are over the opening, even morning by morning.
ylt.9:28: And some of them are over the vessels of service, for by number they bring them in, and by number they take them out.
ylt.9:29: And some of them are appointed over the vessels, even over all the vessels of the sanctuary, and over the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
ylt.9:30: And some of the sons of the priests are mixing the mixture for spices.
ylt.9:31: And Mattithiah, of the Levites (he is the first-born to Shallum the Korahite), is in office over the work of the pans.
ylt.9:32: And of the sons of the Kohathite, some of their brethren are over the bread of the arrangement, to prepare it sabbath by sabbath.
ylt.9:33: And these who sing, heads of fathers of the Levites, in the chambers, are free, for by day and by night they are over them in the work.
ylt.9:34: These heads of the fathers of the Levites throughout their generations are heads. These have dwelt in Jerusalem.
ylt.9:35: And in Gibeon dwelt hath the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, and the name of his wife is Maachah;
ylt.9:36: and his son, the first-born, is Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
ylt.9:37: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
ylt.9:38: And Mikloth begat Shimeam, and they also, over-against their brethren, have dwelt in Jerusalem with their brethren.
ylt.9:39: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-Shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-Baal.
ylt.9:40: And a son of Jonathan is Merib-Baal, and Merib-Baal begat Micah.
ylt.9:41: And sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea,
ylt.9:42: and Ahaz--he begat Jaarah, and Jaarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri, and Zimri begat Moza,
ylt.9:43: and Moza begat Binea, and Rephaiah is his son. Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
ylt.9:44: And to Azel are six sons, and these their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these are sons of Azel.
ylt.10:1: And the Philistines have fought with Israel, and the men of Israel flee from the face of the Philistines, and fall wounded in mount Gilboa,
ylt.10:2: and the Philistines pursue after Saul, and after his sons, and the Philistines smite Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-Shua, sons of Saul.
ylt.10:3: And the battle is heavy on Saul, and those shooting with the bow find him, and he is wounded by those shooting,
ylt.10:4: and Saul saith unto the bearer of his weapons, `Draw thy sword, and pierce me with it, lest these uncircumcised come--and have abused me.' And the bearer of his weapons hath not been willing, for he feareth exceedingly, and Saul taketh the sword, and falleth upon it;
ylt.10:5: and the bearer of his weapons seeth that Saul is dead, and falleth, he also, on the sword, and dieth;
ylt.10:6: and Saul dieth, and his three sons, and all his house--together they died.
ylt.10:7: And all the men of Israel who are in the valley see that they have fled, and that Saul and his sons have died, and they forsake their cities and flee, and the Philistines come and dwell in them.
ylt.10:8: And it cometh to pass, on the morrow, that the Philistines come to strip the wounded, and find Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa,
ylt.10:9: and strip him, and bear away his head, and his weapons, and send into the land of the Philistines round about to proclaim tidings to their idols and the people,
ylt.10:10: and put his weapons in the house of their gods, and his skull they have fixed in the house of Dagon.
ylt.10:11: And all Jabesh-Gilead hear of all that the Philistines have done to Saul,
ylt.10:12: and all the men of valour rise and bear away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and bring them in to Jabesh, and bury their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fast seven days.
ylt.10:13: And Saul dieth because of his trespass that he trespassed against Jehovah, against the word of Jehovah that he kept not, and also for asking at a familiar spirit--to inquire, --
ylt.10:14: and he inquired not at Jehovah, and He putteth him to death, and turneth round the kingdom to David son of Jesse.
ylt.11:1: And gathered are all Israel unto David to Hebron, saying, `Lo, thy bone and thy flesh are we;
ylt.11:2: even in time past, even in Saul's being king, it is thou who art taking out and bringing in Israel, and Jehovah thy God saith to thee: Thou dost feed My people Israel, and thou art leader over My people Israel.'
ylt.11:3: And all the elders of Israel come in unto the king to Hebron, and David maketh with them a covenant in Hebron before Jehovah, and they anoint David for king over Israel, according to the word of Jehovah by the hand of Samuel.
ylt.11:4: And David goeth, and all Israel, to Jerusalem--it is Jebus--and there the Jebusite, the inhabitants of the land.
ylt.11:5: And the inhabitants of Jebus say to David, `Thou dost not come in hither;' and David captureth the fortress of Zion--it is the city of David.
ylt.11:6: And David saith, `Whoever smiteth the Jebusite first doth become head and prince;' and go up first doth Joab son of Zeruiah and becometh head.
ylt.11:7: And David dwelleth in the fortress, therefore they have called it, `City of David;'
ylt.11:8: and he buildeth the city round about, from Millo, and unto the circumference, and Joab restoreth the rest of the city.
ylt.11:9: And David goeth, going on and becoming great, and Jehovah of Hosts is with him.
ylt.11:10: And these are heads of the mighty ones whom David hath, who are strengthening themselves with him in his kingdom, with all Israel, to cause him to reign, according to the word of Jehovah, over Israel.
ylt.11:11: And this is an account of the mighty ones whom David hath: Jashobeam son of a Hachmonite is head of the thirty; he is lifting up his spear against three hundred--wounded, at one time.
ylt.11:12: And after him is Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite, he is among the three mighty;
ylt.11:13: he hath been with David in Pas-Dammim, and the Philistines have been gathered there to battle, and a portion of the field is full of barley, and the people have fled from the face of the Philistines,
ylt.11:14: and they station themselves in the midst of the portion, and deliver it, and smite the Philistines, and Jehovah saveth--a great salvation.
ylt.11:15: And three of the thirty heads go down on the rock unto David, unto the cave of Adullam, and the host of the Philistines is encamping in the valley of Rephaim,
ylt.11:16: and David is then in the fortress, and the station of the Philistines is then in Beth-Lehem,
ylt.11:17: and David longeth, and saith, `Who doth give me to drink water from the well of Beth-Lehem, that is at the gate!'
ylt.11:18: And the three break through the camp of the Philistines, and draw water from the well of Beth-Lehem, that is at the gate, and bear and bring in unto David, and David hath not been willing to drink it, and poureth it out to Jehovah,
ylt.11:19: and saith, `Far be it from me, by my God, to do this; the blood of these men do I drink with their lives? for with their lives they have brought it;' and he was not willing to drink it; these things did the three mighty ones.
ylt.11:20: And Abishai brother of Joab, he hath been head of the three: and he is lifting up his spear against three hundred--wounded, and hath a name among three.
ylt.11:21: Of the three by the two he is honoured, and becometh their head; and unto the first three he hath not come.
ylt.11:22: Benaiah son of Jehoiada, son of a man of valour, of great deeds, from Kabzeel: he hath smitten the two lion-like Moabites, and he hath gone down and smitten the lion in the midst of the pit, in the day of snow.
