ylt.11:23: And he hath smitten the man, the Egyptian--a man of measure, five by the cubit--and in the hand of the Egyptian is a spear like a beam of weavers, and he goeth down unto him with a rod, and taketh violently away the spear out of the hand of the Egyptian, and slayeth him with his own spear.
ylt.11:24: These things hath Benaiah son of Jehoiada done, and hath a name among the three mighty ones.
ylt.11:25: Of the thirty, lo, he is honoured, and unto the first three he hath not come, and David setteth him over his guard.
ylt.11:26: And the mighty ones of the forces are Asahel brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo of Beth-Lehem,
ylt.11:27: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
ylt.11:28: Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi-Ezer the Annethothite,
ylt.11:29: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
ylt.11:30: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite,
ylt.11:31: Ithai son of Ribai of Gibeah, of the sons of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
ylt.11:32: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
ylt.11:33: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
ylt.11:34: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan son of Shage the Hararite,
ylt.11:35: Ahiam son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal son of Ur,
ylt.11:36: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
ylt.11:37: Hezor the Carmelite, Naarai son of Ezbai,
ylt.11:38: Joel brother of Nathan, Mibhar son of Haggeri,
ylt.11:39: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, bearer of the weapons of Joab son of Zeruiah,
ylt.11:40: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
ylt.11:41: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad son of Ahlai,
ylt.11:42: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, head of the Reubenites, and by him thirty,
ylt.11:43: Hanan son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
ylt.11:44: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel sons of Hothan the Aroerite,
ylt.11:45: Jediael son of Shimri, and Joha his brother the Tizite,
ylt.11:46: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
ylt.11:47: Eliel, and Obed, and Jaasiel the Mesobaite.
ylt.12:1: And these are those coming in unto David to Ziklag, while shut up because of Saul son of Kish, and they are among the mighty ones, helping the battle,
ylt.12:2: armed with bow, right and left handed, with stones, and with arrows, with bows, of the brethren of Saul, of Benjamin.
ylt.12:3: The head is Ahiezer, and Joash, sons of Shemaab the Gibeathite, and Jeziel, and Pelet, sons of Azmaveth, and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,
ylt.12:4: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty one among the thirty, and over the thirty, and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite.
ylt.12:5: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
ylt.12:6: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam the Korhites,
ylt.12:7: and Joelah, and Zebadiah, sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
ylt.12:8: And of the Gadite there have been separated unto David, to the fortress, to the wilderness, mighty of valour, men of the host for battle, setting in array target and buckler, and their faces the face of the lion, and as roes on the mountains for speed:
ylt.12:9: Ezer the head, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
ylt.12:10: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
ylt.12:11: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
ylt.12:12: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
ylt.12:13: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbannai the eleventh.
ylt.12:14: These are of the sons of Gad, heads of the host, one of a hundred is the least, and the greatest, of a thousand;
ylt.12:15: these are they who have passed over the Jordan in the first month, --and it is full over all its banks--and cause all they of the valley to flee to the east and to the west.
ylt.12:16: And there come of the sons of Benjamin and Judah unto the stronghold to David,
ylt.12:17: and David goeth out before them, and answereth and saith to them, `If for peace ye have come in unto me, to help me, I have a heart to unite with you; and if to betray me to mine adversaries--without violence in my hands--the God of our fathers doth see and reprove.'
ylt.12:18: And the Spirit hath clothed Amasai, head of the captains: `To thee, O David, and with thee, O son of Jesse--peace! peace to thee, and peace to thy helper, for thy God hath helped thee;' and David receiveth them, and putteth them among the heads of the troop.
ylt.12:19: And of Manasseh there have fallen unto David in his coming with the Philistines against Israel to battle--and they helped them not, for by counsel the princes of the Philistines sent him away, saying, `With our heads he doth fall unto his master Saul.' --
ylt.12:20: In his going unto Ziglag there have fallen unto him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zillthai, heads of the thousands that are of Manasseh;
ylt.12:21: and they have helped with David over the troop, for mighty of valour are all of them, and they are captains in the host,
ylt.12:22: for at that time, day by day, they come in unto David to help him, till it is a great camp, like a camp of God.
ylt.12:23: And these are the numbers of the head, of the armed men of the host; they have come in unto David to Hebron to turn round the kingdom of Saul unto him, according to the mouth of Jehovah.
ylt.12:24: The sons of Judah, bearing target and spear, are six thousand and eight hundred, armed ones of the host.
ylt.12:25: Of the sons of Simeon, mighty ones of valour for the host, are seven thousand and a hundred.
ylt.12:26: Of the sons of Levi are four thousand and six hundred;
ylt.12:27: and Jehoiada is the leader of the Aaronite, and with him are three thousand and seven hundred,
ylt.12:28: and Zadok, a young man, mighty of valour, and of the house of his father are twenty and two heads.
ylt.12:29: And of the sons of Benjamin, brethren of Saul, are three thousand, and hitherto their greater part are keeping the charge of the house of Saul.
ylt.12:30: And of the sons of Ephraim are twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty of valour, men of name, according to the house of their fathers.
ylt.12:31: And of the half of the tribe of Manasseh are eighteen thousand, who have been defined by name, to come in to cause David to reign.
ylt.12:32: And of the sons of Issachar, having understanding for the times, to know what Israel should do; their heads are two hundred, and all their brethren are at their command.
ylt.12:33: Of Zebulun, going forth to the host, arranging battle with all instruments of battle, are fifty thousand, and keeping rank without a double heart.
ylt.12:34: And of Naphtali, a thousand heads, and with them, with target and spear, are thirty and seven thousand.
ylt.12:35: And of the Danite, arranging battle, are twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
ylt.12:36: And of Asher, going forth to the host, to arrange battle, are forty thousand.
ylt.12:37: And from beyond the Jordan, of the Reubenite, and of the Gadite, and of the half of the tribe of Manasseh, with all instruments of the host for battle, are a hundred and twenty thousand.
ylt.12:38: All these are men of war, keeping rank--with a perfect heart they have come to Hebron, to cause David to reign over all Israel, and also all the rest of Israel are of one heart, to cause David to reign,
ylt.12:39: and they are there, with David, three days, eating and drinking, for their brethren have prepared for them.
ylt.12:40: And also those near unto them, unto Issachar, and Zebulun, and Naphtali, are bringing in bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen--food of fine flour, fig-cakes and grape-cakes, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep, in abundance, for joy is in Israel.
ylt.13:1: And David consulteth with the heads of the thousands, and of the hundreds, every leader,
ylt.13:2: and David saith to all the assembly of Israel, `If unto you it be good, and from Jehovah our God it hath broken forth--we send unto our brethren, those left in all the lands of Israel, and with them the priests and the Levites, in the cities of their suburbs, and they are gathered unto us,
ylt.13:3: and we bring round the ark of our God unto us, for we sought Him not in the days of Saul.'
ylt.13:4: And all the assembly say to do so, for the thing is right in the eyes of all the people.
ylt.13:5: And David assembleth all Israel from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering in of Hamath, to bring in the ark of God from Kirjath-Jearim,
ylt.13:6: and David goeth up, and all Israel, to Baalah, unto Kirjath-Jearim that is to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God Jehovah, inhabiting the cherubs, where the Name is called on.
ylt.13:7: And they place the ark of God on a new cart, from the house of Abinadab, and Uzza and Ahio are leading the cart,
ylt.13:8: and David and all Israel are playing before God, with all strength, and with songs, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
ylt.13:9: And they come in unto the threshing-floor of Chidon, and Uzza putteth forth his hand to seize the ark, for the oxen were released,
ylt.13:10: and the anger of Jehovah is kindled against Uzza, and He smiteth him, because that he hath put forth his hand on the ark, and he dieth there before God.
ylt.13:11: And it is displeasing to David, because Jehovah hath made a breach upon Uzza, and one calleth that place `Breach of Uzza' unto this day.
ylt.13:12: And David feareth God on that day, saying, `How do I bring in unto me the ark of God?'
ylt.13:13: And David hath not turned aside the ark unto himself, unto the city of David, and turneth it aside unto the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
ylt.13:14: And the ark of God dwelleth with the household of Obed-Edom, in his house, three months, and Jehovah blesseth the house of Obed-Edom, and all that he hath.
ylt.14:1: And Huram king of Tyre sendeth messengers unto David, and cedar-wood, and artificers of walls, and artificers of wood, to build to him a house.
ylt.14:2: And David knoweth that Jehovah hath established him for king over Israel, because of the lifting up on high of his kingdom, for the sake of His people Israel.
ylt.14:3: And David taketh again wives in Jerusalem, and David begetteth again sons and daughters;
ylt.14:4: and these are the names of the children whom he hath in Jerusalem: Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
ylt.14:5: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
ylt.14:6: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
ylt.14:7: and Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.
ylt.14:8: And the Philistines hear that David hath been anointed for king over all Israel, and all the Philistines go up to seek David, and David heareth, and goeth out before them.
ylt.14:9: And the Philistines have come, and rush into the valley of Rephaim,
ylt.14:10: and David asketh of God, saying, `Do I go up against the Philistines--and hast Thou given them into my hand?' And Jehovah saith to him, `Go up, and I have given them into thy hand.'
ylt.14:11: And they go up into Baal-Perazim, and David smiteth them there, and David saith, `God hath broken up mine enemies by my hand, like the breaking up of waters;' therefore they have called the name of that place Baal-Perazim.
ylt.14:12: And they leave there their gods, and David speaketh, and they are burnt with fire.
ylt.14:13: And the Philistines add again, and rush into the valley,
ylt.14:14: and David asketh again of God, and God saith to him, `Do not go up after them, turn round from them, and thou hast come to them from over-against the mulberries;
ylt.14:15: and it cometh to pass, when thou hearest the sound of the stepping at the heads of the mulberries, then thou goest out into battle, for God hath gone out before thee to smite the camp of the Philistines.'
ylt.14:16: And David doth as God commanded him, and they smite the camp of the Philistines from Gibeon even unto Gazer;
ylt.14:17: and the name of David goeth out into all the lands, and Jehovah hath put his fear on all the nations.
ylt.15:1: And he maketh for himself houses in the city of David, and prepareth a place for the ark of God, and stretcheth out for it a tent.
ylt.15:2: Then said David, `None are to carry the ark of God, except the Levites, for on them hath Jehovah fixed to carry the ark of God, and to serve Him--unto the age.'
ylt.15:3: And David assembleth all Israel unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Jehovah unto its place that he had prepared for it.
ylt.15:4: And David gathereth the sons of Aaron, and the Levites.
ylt.15:5: Of sons of Kohath: Uriel the chief, and his brethren, a hundred and twenty.
ylt.15:6: Of sons of Merari: Asaiah the chief, and his brethren, two hundred and twenty.
ylt.15:7: Of sons of Gershom: Joel the chief, and his brethren, a hundred and thirty.
ylt.15:8: Of sons of Elizaphan: Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren, two hundred.
ylt.15:9: Of sons of Hebron: Eliel the chief, and his brethren, eighty.
ylt.15:10: Of sons of Uzziel: Amminadab the chief, and his brethren, a hundred and twelve.
ylt.15:11: And David calleth to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, and to the Levites, to Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
ylt.15:12: and saith to them, `Ye are heads of the fathers of the Levites; sanctify yourselves, ye and your brethren, and ye have brought up the ark of Jehovah, God of Israel, unto the place I have prepared for it;
ylt.15:13: because at the first it was not ye, Jehovah our God made a breach upon us, because we sought Him not according to the ordinance.'
ylt.15:14: And the priests and the Levites sanctify themselves, to bring up the ark of Jehovah, God of Israel;
ylt.15:15: and sons of the Levites bear the ark of God, as Moses commanded, according to the word of Jehovah, on their shoulder, with staves, above them.
ylt.15:16: And David saith to the heads of the Levites to appoint their brethren the singers, with instruments of song, psalteries, and harps, and cymbals, sounding, to lift up with the voice for joy.
ylt.15:17: And the Levites appoint Heman son of Joel, and of his brethren, Asaph son of Berechiah, and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan son of Kushaiah;
ylt.15:18: and with them their brethren, the seconds in rank, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah; and Obed-Edom and Jeiel the gatekeepers;
ylt.15:19: and the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, with cymbals of brass to sound,
ylt.15:20: and Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jeheil, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries besides virgins,
ylt.15:21: and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps, on the octave, to oversee.
ylt.15:22: And Chenaniah, head of the Levites, is over the burden; he instructeth about the burden, for he is intelligent.
ylt.15:23: And Berechiah and Elkanah are gatekeepers for the ark.
ylt.15:24: And Shebaniah, and Joshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer the priests, are blowing with trumpets before the ark of God; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah are gatekeepers for the ark.
ylt.15:25: And it is David, and the elders of Israel, and the heads of the thousands, who are going to bring up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah from the house of Obed-Edom with joy;
ylt.15:26: and it cometh to pass, in God's helping the Levites bearing the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, that they sacrifice seven bullocks and seven rams.
ylt.15:27: And David is wrapped in an upper robe of fine linen, and all the Levites who are bearing the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah head of the burden of the singers; and on David is an Ephod of linen.
ylt.15:28: And all Israel are bringing up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah with shouting, and with the sound of a cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding with psalteries and harps,
ylt.15:29: and it cometh to pass, the ark of the covenant of Jehovah is entering in unto the city of David, and Michal daughter of Saul is looking through the window, and seeth king David dancing and playing, and despiseth him in her heart.
ylt.16:1: And they bring in the ark of God, and set it up in the midst of the tent that David hath stretched out for it, and they bring near burnt-offerings and peace-offerings before God;
ylt.16:2: and David ceaseth from offering the burnt-offering and the peace-offerings, and blesseth the people in the name of Jehovah,
ylt.16:3: and giveth a portion to every man of Israel, both man and woman: to each a cake of bread, and a measure of wine, and a grape-cake.
ylt.16:4: And he putteth before the ark of Jehovah, of the Levites, ministers, even to make mention of, and to thank, and to give praise to Jehovah, God of Israel,
ylt.16:5: Asaph the head, and his second Zechariah; Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with instruments of psalteries, and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals is sounding;
ylt.16:6: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests are with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
ylt.16:7: On that day then hath David given at the beginning to give thanks to Jehovah by the hand of Asaph and his brethren: --
ylt.16:8: Give thanks to Jehovah, call in His name, Make known among the peoples His doings.
ylt.16:9: Sing ye to Him, sing psalms to Him, Meditate on all His wonders.
ylt.16:10: Boast yourselves in His holy name, Rejoice doth the heart of those seeking Jehovah.
ylt.16:11: Seek ye Jehovah and His strength, Seek His face continually.
ylt.16:12: Remember His wonders that He did, His signs, and the judgments of His mouth,
ylt.16:13: O seed of Israel, His servant, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones!
ylt.16:14: He is Jehovah our God, In all the earth are His judgments.
ylt.16:15: Remember ye to the age His covenant, The word He commanded--To a thousand generations,
ylt.16:16: Which He hath made with Abraham, And His oath--to Isaac,
ylt.16:17: And He establisheth it to Jacob for a statute, To Israel--a covenant age-during.
ylt.16:18: Saying: To thee I give the land of Canaan, The portion of your inheritance,
ylt.16:19: When ye are few of number, As a little thing, and sojourners in it.
ylt.16:20: And they go up and down, From nation unto nation, And from a kingdom unto another people.
ylt.16:21: He hath not suffered any to oppress them, And reproveth on their account kings:
ylt.16:22: Come not against Mine anointed ones, And against My prophets do not evil.
ylt.16:23: Sing to Jehovah, all the earth, Proclaim from day unto day His salvation.
ylt.16:24: Rehearse among nations His glory, Among all the peoples His wonders.
ylt.16:25: For great is Jehovah, and praised greatly, And fearful He is above all gods.
ylt.16:26: For all gods of the peoples are nought, And Jehovah the heavens hath made.
ylt.16:27: Honour and majesty are before Him, Strength and joy are in His place.
ylt.16:28: Ascribe to Jehovah, ye families of peoples, Ascribe to Jehovah honour and strength.
ylt.16:29: Ascribe to Jehovah the honour of His name, Lift up a present, and come before Him. Bow yourselves to Jehovah, In the beauty of holiness.
ylt.16:30: Be pained before Him, all the earth:
ylt.16:31: Also, established is the world, It is not moved! The heavens rejoice, and the earth is glad, And they say among nations: Jehovah hath reigned.
ylt.16:32: Roar doth the sea, and its fulness, Exult doth the field, and all that is in it,
ylt.16:33: Then sing do trees of the forest, From the presence of Jehovah, For He hath come to judge the earth!
ylt.16:34: Give thanks to Jehovah, for good, For to the age, is His kindness,
ylt.16:35: And say, Save us, O God of our salvation, And gather us, and deliver us from the nations, To give thanks to Thy holy name, To triumph in Thy praise.
ylt.16:36: Blessed is Jehovah, God of Israel, From the age and unto the age;' And all the people say, `Amen,' and have given praise to Jehovah.
ylt.16:37: And he leaveth there before the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, for Asaph and for his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, according to the matter of a day in its day,
ylt.16:38: both Obed-Edom and their brethren, sixty and eight, and Obed-Edom son of Jeduthun, and Hosah for gatekeepers,
ylt.16:39: and Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of Jehovah, in a high place that is in Gibeon,
ylt.16:40: to cause to ascend burnt-offerings to Jehovah, on the altar of burnt-offering continually, morning and evening, and for all that is written in the law of Jehovah, that He charged on Israel.
ylt.16:41: And with them are Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest of those chosen, who were defined by name, to give thanks to Jehovah, for to the age is His kindness,
ylt.16:42: and with them--Heman and Jeduthun-- are trumpets and cymbals for those sounding, and instruments of the song of God, and the sons of Jeduthun are at the gate.
ylt.16:43: And all the people go, each to his house, and David turneth round to bless his house.
ylt.17:1: And it cometh to pass as David sat in his house, that David saith unto Nathan the prophet, `Lo, I am dwelling in a house of cedars, and the ark of the covenant of Jehovah is under curtains;'
ylt.17:2: and Nathan saith unto David, `All that is in thy heart do, for God is with thee.'
ylt.17:3: And it cometh to pass on that night that a word of God is unto Nathan, saying,
ylt.17:4: `Go, and thou hast said unto David My servant, Thus said Jehovah, Thou dost not build for Me the house to dwell in:
ylt.17:5: for I have not dwelt in a house from the day that I brought up Israel till this day, and I am from tent unto tent: and from the tabernacle,
ylt.17:6: whithersoever I have walked up and down among all Israel, a word spake I, with one of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed My people, saying, Why have ye not built for Me a house of cedars?
ylt.17:7: `And now, thus dost thou say to My servant, to David, Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, I have taken thee from the habitation, from after the sheep, to be leader over My people Israel,
ylt.17:8: and I am with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and I cut off all thine enemies from thy presence, and have made for thee a name like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.
ylt.17:9: `And I have prepared a place for My people Israel, and planted it, and it hath dwelt in its place, and is not troubled any more, and the sons of perverseness add not to wear it out as at first,
ylt.17:10: yea, even from the days that I appointed judges over My people Israel. `And I have humbled all thine enemies, and I declare to thee that a house doth Jehovah build for thee,
ylt.17:11: and it hath come to pass, when thy days have been fulfilled to go with thy fathers, that I have raised up thy seed after thee, who is of thy sons, and I have established his kingdom,
ylt.17:12: he doth build for Me a house, and I have established his throne unto the age;
ylt.17:13: I am to him for a father, and he is to Me for a son, and My kindness I turn not aside from him as I turned it aside from him who was before thee,
ylt.17:14: and I have established him in My house, and in My kingdom unto the age, and his throne is established unto the age.'
ylt.17:15: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so spake Nathan unto David.
ylt.17:16: And David the king cometh in and sitteth before Jehovah, and saith, `Who am I, O Jehovah God, and what my house, that Thou hast brought me hitherto?
ylt.17:17: And this is small in Thine eyes, O God, and Thou speakest concerning the house of thy servant afar off, and hast seen me as a type of the man who is on high, O Jehovah God!
ylt.17:18: `What doth David add more unto Thee for the honour of Thy servant; and Thou Thy servant hast known.
ylt.17:19: O Jehovah, for Thy servant's sake, and according to Thine own heart Thou hast done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.
ylt.17:20: O Jehovah, there is none like Thee, and there is no god save Thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
ylt.17:21: `And who is as Thy people Israel, one nation in the earth whom God hath gone to ransom to Him for a people, to make for Thee a name great and fearful, to cast out from the presence of Thy people whom Thou hast ransomed out of Egypt--nations?
ylt.17:22: Yea, Thou dost appoint Thy people Israel to Thee for a people unto the age, and Thou, O Jehovah, hast been to them for God.
ylt.17:23: `And now, O Jehovah, the word that Thou hast spoken concerning Thy servant, and concerning his house, let be stedfast unto the age, and do as Thou hast spoken;
ylt.17:24: and let it be stedfast, and Thy name is great unto the age, saying, Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, is God to Israel, and the house of Thy servant David is established before Thee;
ylt.17:25: for Thou, O my God, Thou hast uncovered the ear of Thy servant--to build to him a house, therefore hath Thy servant found to pray before Thee.
ylt.17:26: `And now, Jehovah, Thou art God Himself, and Thou speakest concerning Thy servant this goodness;
ylt.17:27: and now, Thou hast been pleased to bless the house of Thy servant, to be to the age before Thee; for Thou, O Jehovah, hast blessed, and it is blessed to the age.'
ylt.18:1: And it cometh to pass after this, that David smiteth the Philistines, and humbleth them, and taketh Gath and its small towns out of the hand of the Philistines;
ylt.18:2: and he smiteth Moab, and the Moabites are servants to David, bringing a present.
ylt.18:3: And David smiteth Hadarezer king of Zobah, at Hamath, in his going to establish his power by the river Phrat,
ylt.18:4: and David captureth from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen, and David destroyeth utterly all the chariots, and leaveth of them a hundred chariots only.
ylt.18:5: And Aram of Damascus cometh in to give help to Hadarezer king of Zobah, and David smiteth in Aram twenty and two thousand men,
ylt.18:6: and David putteth garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Aramaeans are to David for servants, bearing a present, and Jehovah giveth salvation to David whithersoever he hath gone.
ylt.18:7: And David taketh the shields of gold that have been on the servants of Hadarezer, and bringeth them in to Jerusalem;
ylt.18:8: and from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, hath David taken very much brass; with it hath Solomon made the brazen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
ylt.18:9: And Tou king of Hamath heareth that David hath smitten the whole force of Hadarezer king of Zobah,
ylt.18:10: and he sendeth Hadoram his son unto king David, to ask of him of peace, and to bless him (because that he hath fought against Hadarezer, and smiteth him, for a man of wars with Tou had Hadarezer been,) and all kinds of vessels, of gold, and silver, and brass;
ylt.18:11: also them hath king David sanctified to Jehovah with the silver and the gold that he hath taken from all the nations, from Edom, and from Moab, and from the sons of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
ylt.18:12: And Abishai son of Zeruiah hath smitten Edom in the valley of salt--eighteen thousand,
ylt.18:13: and he putteth in Edom garrisons, and all the Edomites are servants to David; and Jehovah saveth David whithersoever he hath gone.
ylt.18:14: And David reigneth over all Israel, and he is doing judgment and righteousness to all his people,
ylt.18:15: and Joab son of Zeruiah is over the host, and Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud is remembrancer,
ylt.18:16: and Zadok son of Ahitub, and Abimelech son of Abiathar, are priests, and Shavsha is scribe,
ylt.18:17: and Benaiah son of Jehoiada is over the Cherethite and the Pelethite, and the elder sons of David are at the hand of the king.
ylt.19:1: And it cometh to pass after this, that Nahash king of the sons of Ammon dieth, and his son reigneth in his stead,
ylt.19:2: and David saith, `I do kindness with Hanun son of Nahash, for his father did with me kindness;' and David sendeth messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And the servants of David come in unto the land of the sons of Ammon, unto Hanun, to comfort him,
ylt.19:3: and the heads of the sons of Ammon say to Hanun, `Is David honouring thy father, in thine eyes, because he hath sent to thee comforters? in order to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out, the land, have not his servants come in unto thee?'
ylt.19:4: And Hanun taketh the servants of David, and shaveth them, and cutteth their long robes in the midst, unto the buttocks, and sendeth them away.
ylt.19:5: And some go, and declare to David concerning the men, and he sendeth to meet them--for the men have been greatly ashamed--and the king saith, `Dwell in Jericho till that your beard is grown, then ye have returned.'
ylt.19:6: And the sons of Ammon see that they have made themselves abhorred by David, and Hanun and the sons of Ammon send a thousand talents of silver, to hire to them, from Aram-Naharaim, and from Aram-Maachah, and from Zobah, chariots and horsemen;
ylt.19:7: and they hire to them two and thirty thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people, and they come in and encamp before Medeba, and the sons of Ammon have been gathered out of their cities, and come in to the battle.
ylt.19:8: And David heareth, and sendeth Joab, and all the host of the mighty men,
ylt.19:9: and the sons of Ammon come out and set battle in array at the opening of the city, and the kings who have come are by themselves in the field.
ylt.19:10: And Joab seeth that the front of the battle hath been unto him, before and behind, and he chooseth out of all the choice in Israel, and setteth in array to meet Aram,
ylt.19:11: and the remnant of the people he hath given into the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set in array to meet the sons of Ammon.
ylt.19:12: And he saith, `If Aram be stronger than I, then thou hast been to me for salvation; and if the sons of Ammon be stronger than thou, then I have saved thee;
ylt.19:13: be strong, and we strengthen ourselves, for our people, and for the cities of our God, and Jehovah doth that which is good in His eyes.'
ylt.19:14: And Joab draweth nigh, and the people who are with him, before Aram to battle, and they flee from his face;
ylt.19:15: and the sons of Ammon have seen that Aram hath fled, and they flee--they also--from the face of Abishai his brother, and go in to the city. And Joab cometh in to Jerusalem.
ylt.19:16: And Aram seeth that they have been smitten before Israel, and send messengers, and bring out Aram that is beyond the River, and Shophach head of the host of Hadarezer is before them.
ylt.19:17: And it is declared to David, and he gathereth all Israel, and passeth over the Jordan, and cometh in unto them, and setteth in array against them; yea, David setteth in array the battle to meet Aram, and they fight with him;
ylt.19:18: and Aram fleeth from the face of Israel, and David slayeth of Aram seven thousand charioteers, and forty thousand footmen, and Shophach head of the host he hath put to death.
ylt.19:19: And the servants of Hadarezer see that they have been smitten before Israel, and they make peace with David and serve him, and Aram hath not been willing to help the sons of Ammon any more.
ylt.20:1: And it cometh to pass, at the time of the turn of the year--at the time of the going out of the messengers--that Joab leadeth out the force of the host, and destroyeth the land of the sons of Ammon, and cometh in and beseigeth Rabbah--David is abiding in Jerusalem--and Joab smiteth Rabbah, and breaketh it down.
ylt.20:2: And David taketh the crown of their king from off his head, and findeth it in weight a talent of gold, and in it a precious stone, and it is on the head of David: and spoil of the city he hath brought out very much,
ylt.20:3: and the people who are in it he hath brought out, and setteth to the saw, and to cutting instruments of iron, and to axes; and thus doth David to all cities of the sons of Ammon, and David turneth back, and all the people, to Jerusalem.
ylt.20:4: And it cometh to pass, after this, that there remaineth war in Gezer with the Philistines, then hath Sibbechai the Hushathite smitten Sippai, of the children of the giant, and they are humbled.
ylt.20:5: And there is again war with the Philistines, and Elhanan son of Jair smiteth Lahmi, brother of Goliath the Gittite, the wood of whose spear is like a beam of weavers.
ylt.20:6: And there is again war in Gath, and there is a man of measure, and his fingers and his toes are six and six, twenty and four, and also, he hath been born to the giant.
ylt.20:7: And he reproacheth Israel, and smite him doth Jonathan son of Shimea, brother of David.
ylt.20:8: These were born to the giant in Gath, and they fall by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
ylt.21:1: And there standeth up an adversary against Israel, and persuadeth David to number Israel,
ylt.21:2: And David saith unto Joab, and unto the heads of the people, `Go, number Israel from Beer-Sheba even unto Dan, and bring unto me, and I know their number.'
ylt.21:3: And Joab saith, `Jehovah doth add to His people as they are a hundred times; are they not, my lord, O king, all of them to my lord for servants? why doth my lord seek this? why is he for a cause of guilt to Israel?'
ylt.21:4: And the word of the king is severe against Joab, and Joab goeth out, and goeth up and down in all Israel, and cometh in to Jerusalem.
ylt.21:5: And Joab giveth the account of the numbering of the people unto David, and all Israel is a thousand thousand and a hundred thousand, each drawing sword, and Judah is four hundred and seventy thousand, each drawing sword.
ylt.21:6: And Levi and Benjamin he hath not numbered in their midst, for the word of the king was abominable with Joab.
ylt.21:7: And it is evil in the eyes of God concerning this thing, and He smiteth Israel,
ylt.21:8: and David saith unto God, `I have sinned exceedingly, in that I have done this thing; and now, cause to pass away, I pray Thee, the iniquity of Thy servant, for I have acted very foolishly.'
ylt.21:9: And Jehovah speaketh unto Gad, seer of David, saying:
ylt.21:10: `Go, and thou hast spoken unto David, saying, Thus said Jehovah, Three--I am stretching out unto thee; choose for thee one of these, and I do it to thee.'
ylt.21:11: And Gad cometh in unto David, and saith to him, `Thus said Jehovah, Take for thee--
ylt.21:12: either for three years--famine, or three months to be consumed from the face of thine adversaries, even the sword of thine enemies to overtake, or three days the sword of Jehovah, even pestilence in the land, and a messenger of Jehovah destroying in all the border of Israel; and now, see; what word do I return to Him who is sending me?'
ylt.21:13: And David saith unto Gad, `I am greatly distressed, let me fall, I pray thee, into the hand of Jehovah, for very many are His mercies, and into the hand of man let me not fall.'
ylt.21:14: And Jehovah giveth a pestilence in Israel, and there fall of Israel seventy thousand men,
ylt.21:15: and God sendeth a messenger to Jerusalem to destroy it, and as he is destroying Jehovah hath seen, and is comforted concerning the evil, and saith to the messenger who is destroying, `Enough, now, cease thy hand.' And the messenger of Jehovah is standing by the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite,
ylt.21:16: and David lifteth up his eyes, and seeth the messenger of Jehovah standing between the earth and the heavens, and his sword drawn in his hand, stretched out over Jerusalem, and David falleth, and the elders, covered with sackcloth, on their faces.
ylt.21:17: And David saith unto God, `Did not I--I say to number the people? Yea, I it is who have sinned, and done great evil: and these, the flock, what did they? O Jehovah, my God, let, I pray Thee, Thy hand be on me, and on the house of my father, and not on Thy people--to be plagued.'
ylt.21:18: And the messenger of Jehovah spake unto Gad, saying for David, `Surely David doth go up to raise an altar to Jehovah in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.'
ylt.21:19: And David goeth up by the word of Gad, that he spake in the name of Jehovah.
ylt.21:20: And Ornan turneth back, and seeth the messenger, and his four sons are with him, hiding themselves, and Ornan is threshing wheat.
ylt.21:21: And David cometh in unto Ornan, and Ornan looketh attentively, and seeth David, and goeth out from the threshing-floor, and boweth himself to David--face to the earth.
ylt.21:22: And David saith unto Ornan, `Give to me the place of the threshing-floor, and I build in it an altar to Jehovah; for full silver give it to me, and the plague is restrained from the people.'
ylt.21:23: And Ornan saith unto David, `Take to thee--and my lord the king doth that which is good in his eyes: see, I have given the oxen for burnt-offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for a present; the whole I have given.'
ylt.21:24: And king David saith to Ornan, `Nay, for I surely buy for full silver; for I do not lift up that which is thine to Jehovah, so as to offer a burnt-offering without cost.'
ylt.21:25: And David giveth to Ornan for the place shekels of gold in weight six hundred;
ylt.21:26: and David buildeth there an altar to Jehovah, and offereth burnt-offerings and peace-offerings, and calleth unto Jehovah, and He answereth him with fire from the heavens on the altar of the burnt-offering.
ylt.21:27: And Jehovah saith to the messenger, and he turneth back his sword unto its sheath.
ylt.21:28: At that time when David seeth that Jehovah hath answered him in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificeth there;
ylt.21:29: and the tabernacle of Jehovah that Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt-offering, are at that time in a high place, in Gibeon;
ylt.21:30: and David is not able to go before it to seek God, for he hath been afraid because of the sword of the messenger of Jehovah.
ylt.22:1: And David saith, `This is the house of Jehovah God, and this the altar for burnt-offering for Israel.'
ylt.22:2: And David saith to gather the sojourners who are in the land of Israel, and appointeth hewers to hew hewn-stones to build a house of God.
ylt.22:3: And iron in abundance for nails for leaves of the gates, and for couplings, hath David prepared, and brass in abundance--there is no weighing.
ylt.22:4: And cedar-trees even without number, for the Zidonians and the Tyrians brought in cedar-trees in abundance to David.
ylt.22:5: And David saith, `Solomon my son is a youth and tender, and the house to be built to Jehovah is to be made exceedingly great, for name and for beauty to all the lands; let me prepare, I pray Thee, for it;' and David prepareth in abundance before his death.
ylt.22:6: And he calleth for Solomon his son, and chargeth him to build a house to Jehovah, God of Israel,
ylt.22:7: and David saith to Solomon his son, `As for me, it hath been with my heart to build a house to the name of Jehovah my God,
ylt.22:8: and the word of Jehovah is against me, saying, Blood in abundance thou hast shed, and great wars thou hast made: thou dost not build a house to My name, for much blood thou hast shed to the earth before Me.
ylt.22:9: `Lo, a son is born to thee; he is a man of rest, and I have given rest to him from all his enemies round about, for Solomon is his name, and peace and quietness I give unto Israel in his days;
ylt.22:10: he doth build a house to My name, and he is to Me for a son, and I am to him for a father, and I have established the throne of his kingdom over Israel unto the age.
ylt.22:11: `Now, my son, Jehovah is with thee, and thou hast prospered, and hast built the house of Jehovah thy God, as He spake concerning thee.
ylt.22:12: Only, Jehovah give to thee wisdom and understanding, and charge thee concerning Israel, even to keep the law of Jehovah thy God;
ylt.22:13: then thou dost prosper, if thou dost observe to do the statutes and the judgments that Jehovah charged Moses with concerning Israel; be strong and courageous; do not fear, nor be cast down.
ylt.22:14: `And lo, in mine affliction, I have prepared for the house of Jehovah of gold talents a hundred thousand, and of silver a thousand thousand talents; and of brass and of iron there is no weighing, for in abundance it hath been, and wood and stones I have prepared, and to them thou dost add.
ylt.22:15: `And with thee in abundance are workmen, hewers and artificers of stone and of wood, and every skilful man for every work.
ylt.22:16: To the gold, to the silver, and to the brass, and to the iron, there is no number; arise and do, and Jehovah is with thee.'
ylt.22:17: And David giveth charge to all heads of Israel to give help to Solomon his son,
ylt.22:18: `Is not Jehovah your God with you? yea, He hath given rest to you round about, for He hath given into my hand the inhabitants of the land, and subdued hath been the land before His people.
ylt.22:19: `Now, give your heart and your soul to seek to Jehovah your God, and rise and build the sanctuary of Jehovah God, to bring in the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and the holy vessels of God, to the house that is built to the name of Jehovah.'
ylt.23:1: And David is old, and satisfied with days, and causeth his son Solomon to reign over Israel,
ylt.23:2: and gathereth all the heads of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites;
ylt.23:3: and the Levites are numbered from a son of thirty years and upward, and their number, by their polls, is of mighty men thirty and eight thousand.
ylt.23:4: Of these to preside over the work of the house of Jehovah are twenty and four thousand, and officers and judges six thousand,
ylt.23:5: and four thousand gatekeepers, and four thousand giving praise to Jehovah, `with instruments that I made for praising,' saith David.
ylt.23:6: And David distributeth them into courses: Of the sons of Levi: of Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
ylt.23:7: Of the Gershonite: Laadan and Shimei.
ylt.23:8: Sons of Laadan: the head is Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
ylt.23:9: Sons of Shimei are Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three; these are heads of the fathers of Laadan.
ylt.23:10: And sons of Shimei are Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah; these are sons of Shimei, four.
ylt.23:11: And Jahath is the head, and Zizah the second, and Jeush and Beriah have not multiplied sons, and they become the house of a father by one numbering.
ylt.23:12: Sons of Kohath are Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
ylt.23:13: Sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron is separated for his sanctifying the holy of holies, he and his sons--unto the age, to make perfume before Jehovah, to serve Him, and to bless in His name--unto the age.
ylt.23:14: As to Moses, the man of God, his sons are called after the tribe of Levi.
ylt.23:15: Sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
ylt.23:16: Sons of Gershom: Shebuel the head.
ylt.23:17: And sons of Eliezer are Rehabiah the head, and Eliezer had no other sons, and the sons of Rehabiah have multiplied exceedingly.
ylt.23:18: Sons of Izhar: Shelomith the head.
ylt.23:19: Sons of Hebron: Jeriah the head, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
ylt.23:20: Sons of Uzziel: Micah the head, and Ishshiah, the second.
ylt.23:21: Sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
ylt.23:22: And Eleazar dieth, and he had no sons, but daughters, and sons of Kish their brethren take them.
ylt.23:23: Sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth, three.
ylt.23:24: These are sons of Levi, by the house of their fathers, heads of the fathers, by their appointments, in the number of names, by their polls, doing the work for the service of the house of Jehovah, from a son of twenty years and upward,
ylt.23:25: for David said, `Jehovah, God of Israel, hath given rest to His people, and He doth tabernacle in Jerusalem unto the age;'
ylt.23:26: and also of the Levites, `None are to bear the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service;'
ylt.23:27: for by the last words of David they took the number of the sons of Levi from a son of twenty years and upward,
ylt.23:28: for their station is at the side of the sons of Aaron, for the service of the house of Jehovah, over the courts, and over the chambers, and over the cleansing of every holy thing, and the work of the service of the house of God,
ylt.23:29: and for the bread of the arrangement, and for fine flour for present, and for the thin unleavened cakes, and for the work of the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all liquid measure and solid measure;
ylt.23:30: and to stand, morning by morning, to give thanks, and to give praise to Jehovah, and so at evening;
ylt.23:31: and for all the burnt-offerings--burnt-offerings to Jehovah for sabbaths, for new moons, and for appointed seasons, by number, according to the ordinance upon them continually, before Jehovah.
ylt.23:32: And they have kept the charge of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the sons of Aaron, their brethren, for the service of the house of Jehovah.
ylt.24:1: And to the sons of Aaron are their courses: sons of Aaron are Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar,
ylt.24:2: and Nadab dieth, and Abihu, in the presence of their father, and they had no sons, and Eleazar and Ithamar act as priests.
ylt.24:3: And David distributeth them, and Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their office in their service;
ylt.24:4: and there are found of the sons of Eleazar more for heads of the mighty men than of the sons of Ithamar; and they distribute them: Of the sons of Eleazar, heads for a house of fathers, sixteen; and of the sons of Ithamar, for a house of their fathers, eight.
ylt.24:5: And they distribute them, by lots, one with another, for princes of the sanctuary, and princes of God, have been of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
ylt.24:6: And Shemaiah son of Nethaneel the scribe, of the Levites, writeth them before the king and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and heads of the fathers, for priests and for Levites: one house of a father being taken possession of for Eleazar, and one being taken possession of for Ithamar.
ylt.24:7: And the first lot goeth out for Jehoiarib, for Jedaiah the second,
ylt.24:8: for Harim the third, for Seorim the fourth,
ylt.24:9: for Malchijah the fifth, for Mijamin the sixth,
ylt.24:10: for Hakkoz the seventh, for Abijah the eighth,
ylt.24:11: for Jeshuah the ninth, for Shecaniah the tenth,
ylt.24:12: for Eliashib the eleventh, for Jakim the twelfth,
ylt.24:13: for Huppah the thirteenth, for Jeshebeab the fourteenth,
ylt.24:14: for Bilgah the fifteenth, for Immer the sixteenth,
ylt.24:15: for Hezir the seventeenth, for Aphses the eighteenth,
ylt.24:16: for Pethahiah the nineteenth, for Jehezekel the twentieth,
ylt.24:17: for Jachin the one and twentieth, for Gamul the two and twentieth,
ylt.24:18: for Delaiah the three and twentieth, for Maaziah the four and twentieth.
ylt.24:19: These are their appointments for their service, to come in to the house of Jehovah, according to their ordinance by the hand of Aaron their father, as Jehovah God of Israel, commanded them.
ylt.24:20: And for the sons of Levi who are left: for sons of Amram, Shubael; for sons of Shubael: Jehdeiah.
ylt.24:21: For Rehabiah: for sons of Rehabiah, the head Ishshiah.
ylt.24:22: For the Izharite: Shelomoth; for sons of Shelomoth: Jahath.
ylt.24:23: And sons of Jeriah: Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
ylt.24:24: Sons of Uzziel: Michah; for sons of Michah: Shamir.
ylt.24:25: A brother of Michah is Ishshiah; for sons of Ishshiah: Zechariah;
ylt.24:26: sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; sons of Jaaziah: Beno;
ylt.24:27: sons of Merari: of Jaaziah: Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
ylt.24:28: For Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons;
ylt.24:29: for Kish: sons of Kish: Jerahmeel.
ylt.24:30: And sons of Mushi are Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth; these are sons of the Levites, for the house of their fathers,
ylt.24:31: and they cast, they also, lots over-against their brethren the sons of Aaron, before David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and heads of the fathers, for priests and for Levites; the chief father over-against his younger brother.
ylt.25:1: And David and the heads of the host separate for service, of the sons of Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun, who are prophesying with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals, and the number of the workmen is according to their service.
ylt.25:2: Of sons of Asaph: Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asharelah, sons of Asaph, are by the side of Asaph, who is prophesying by the side of the king.
ylt.25:3: Of Jeduthun: sons of Jeduthun, Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, Shisshah, are by the side of their father Jeduthun; with a harp he is prophesying, for giving of thanks and of praise to Jehovah.
ylt.25:4: Of Heman: sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth;
ylt.25:5: all these are sons of Heman--seer of the king in the things of God--to lift up a horn; and God giveth to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
ylt.25:6: All these are by the side of their father in the song of the house of Jehovah, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God; by the side of the king are Asaph, and Jeduthun, and Heman.
ylt.25:7: And their number, with their brethren--taught in the song of Jehovah, all who are intelligent--is two hundred, eighty and eight.
ylt.25:8: And they cause to fall lots--charge over-against charge, as well the small as the great, the intelligent with the learner.
ylt.25:9: And the first lot goeth out for Asaph to Joseph; to Gedaliah the second; he, and his brethren and his sons, twelve;
ylt.25:10: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:11: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:12: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:13: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:14: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:15: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:16: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:17: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
ylt.25:18: eleventh to Azareel, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:19: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:20: at the thirteenth to Shubael, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:21: at the fourteenth to Mattithiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:22: at the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:23: at the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:24: at the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:25: at the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:26: at the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:27: at the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:28: at the one and twentieth to Hothir, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:29: at the two and twentieth to Giddalti, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:30: at the three and twentieth to Mahazioth, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
ylt.25:31: at the four and twentieth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brethren, twelve.
ylt.26:1: For the courses of the gatekeepers: of the Korhites is Meshelemiah son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph;
ylt.26:2: and to Meshelemiah are sons, Zechariah the first-born, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
ylt.26:3: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
ylt.26:4: And to Obed-Edom are sons, Shemaiah the first-born, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,
ylt.26:5: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peullethai the eighth, for God hath blessed him.
ylt.26:6: And to Shemaiah his son have sons been born, who are ruling throughout the house of their father, for they are mighty of valour.
ylt.26:7: Sons of Shemaiah are Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad; his brethren are sons of valour, Elihu and Semachiah,
ylt.26:8: all these are of the sons of Obed-Edom; they, and their sons, and their brethren, men of valour with might for service, are sixty and two of Obed-Edom.
ylt.26:9: And to Meshelemiah are sons and brethren, sons of valour, eighteen;
ylt.26:10: and to Hosah, of the sons of Merari, are sons: Shimri the head (though he was not first-born, yet his father setteth him for head),
ylt.26:11: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth; all the sons and brethren of Hosah are thirteen.
ylt.26:12: According to these are the courses of the gatekeepers; to the heads of the mighty ones are charges over-against their brethren, to minister in the house of Jehovah,
ylt.26:13: and they cause to fall lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for gate and gate.
ylt.26:14: And the lot falleth eastward to Shelemiah; and for Zechariah his son--a counsellor with understanding--they cause to fall lots, and his lot goeth out northward:
ylt.26:15: to Obed-Edom southward, and to his sons, the house of the gatherings;
ylt.26:16: to Shuppim and to Hosah to the west, with the gate Shallecheth, in the highway, the ascent, charge over-against charge;
ylt.26:17: to the east the Levites are six; to the north daily four, to the south daily four, and to the gatherings two by two,
ylt.26:18: at Parbar, to the west, are four at the highway, two at Parbar.
ylt.26:19: These are the courses of the gatekeepers, of the sons of the Korhite, and of the sons of Merari.
ylt.26:20: And of the Levites, Ahijah is over the treasures of the house of God, even for the treasures of the holy things.
ylt.26:21: Sons of Laadan: sons of the Gershonite, of Laadan, heads of the fathers of Laadan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
ylt.26:22: Sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the house of Jehovah,
ylt.26:23: for the Amramite, for the Izharite, for the Hebronite, for the Uzzielite.
ylt.26:24: And Shebuel son of Gershom, son of Moses, is president over the treasures.
ylt.26:25: And his brethren, of Eliezer, are Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
ylt.26:26: This Shelomith and his brethren are over all the treasures of the holy things, that David the king, and heads of the fathers, even heads of thousands, and of hundreds, and heads of the host, sanctified;
ylt.26:27: from the battles, even from the spoil they sanctified to strengthen the house of Jehovah;
ylt.26:28: and all that Samuel the seer, and Saul son of Kish, and Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Zeruiah sanctified, every one sanctifying any thing--it is by the side of Shelomith and his brethren.
ylt.26:29: Of the Izharite, Chenaniah and his sons are for the outward work over Israel, for officers and for judges.
ylt.26:30: Of the Hebronite, Hashabiah and his brethren, sons of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, are over the inspection of Israel, beyond the Jordan westward, for all the work of Jehovah, and for the service of the king.
ylt.26:31: Of the Hebronite, Jerijah is the head, of the Hebronite, according to his generations, for the fathers--in the fortieth year of the reign of David they have been sought out, and there are found among them mighty ones of valour, in Jazer of Gilead--
ylt.26:32: and his brethren, sons of valour, two thousand and seven hundred, are heads of the fathers, and king David appointeth them over the Reubenite, and the Gadite, and the half of the tribe of Manasseh, for every matter of God and matter of the king.
ylt.27:1: And the sons of Israel, after their number, heads of the fathers, and princes of the thousands and of the hundreds, and their officers, those serving the king in any matter of the courses, that are coming in and going out month by month, throughout all months of the year-- are in each course twenty and four thousand.
ylt.27:2: Over the first course, for the first month, is Jashobeam son of Zabdiel, and on his course are twenty and four thousand;
ylt.27:3: of the sons of Perez is the head of all princes of the hosts for the first month.
ylt.27:4: And over the course of the second month is Dodai the Ahohite, and his course, and Mikloth is the president, and on his course are twenty and four thousand.
ylt.27:5: Head of the third host, for the third month, is Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the head priest, and on his course are twenty and four thousand.
ylt.27:6: This Benaiah is a mighty one of the thirty, and over the thirty, and in his course is Ammizabad his son.
ylt.27:7: The fourth, for the fourth month, is Asahel brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him, and on his course are twenty and four thousand.
ylt.27:8: The fifth, for the fifth month, is the prince Shamhuth the Izrahite, and on his course are twenty and four thousand.
ylt.27:9: The sixth, for the sixth month, is Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, and on his course are twenty and four thousand.
ylt.27:10: The seventh, for the seventh month, is Helez the Pelonite, of the sons of Ephraim, and on his course are twenty and four thousand.
ylt.27:11: The eighth, for the eighth month, is Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhite, and on his course are twenty and four thousand.
ylt.27:12: The ninth, for the ninth month, is Abiezer the Antothite, of the Benjamite, and on his course are twenty and four thousand.
ylt.27:13: The tenth, for the tenth month, is Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhite, and on his course are twenty and four thousand.
ylt.27:14: Eleventh, for the eleventh month, is Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the sons of Ephraim, and on his course are twenty and four thousand.
ylt.27:15: The twelfth, for the twelfth month, is Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel, and on his course are twenty and four thousand.
ylt.27:16: And over the tribes of Israel: Of the Reubenite, a leader is Eliezer son of Zichri; of the Simeonite, Shephatiah son of Maachah;
ylt.27:17: of the Levite, Hashabiah son of Kemuel; of the Aaronite, Zadok;
ylt.27:18: of Judah, Elihu, of the brethren of David; of Issachar, Omri son of Michael;
ylt.27:19: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jerimoth son of Azriel;
ylt.27:20: of the sons of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Azaziah; of the half of the tribe of Manasseh, Joel son of Pedaiah;
ylt.27:21: of the half of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel son of Abner; of Dan, Azareel son of Jeroham:
ylt.27:22: these are heads of the tribes of Israel.
ylt.27:23: And David hath not taken up their number from a son of twenty years and under, for Jehovah said to multiply Israel as the stars of the heavens.
ylt.27:24: Joab son of Zeruiah hath begun to number--and hath not finished--and there is for this wrath against Israel, and the number hath not gone up in the account of the Chronicles of king David.
ylt.27:25: And over the treasures of the king is Azmaveth son of Adiel; and over the treasures in the field, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the towers, is Jehonathan son of Uzziah;
ylt.27:26: and over workmen of the field for the service of the ground is Ezri son of Chelub;
ylt.27:27: and over the vineyards is Shimei the Ramathite; and over what is in the vineyards for the treasures of wine is Zabdi the Shiphmite;
ylt.27:28: and over the olives, and the sycamores, that are in the low country, is Baal-Hanan the Gederite; and over the treasures of oil is Joash;
ylt.27:29: and over the herds that are feeding in Sharon is Shitrai the Sharonite; and over the herds in the valleys is Shaphat son of Adlai;
ylt.27:30: and over the camels is Obil the Ishmeelite; and over the asses is Jehdeiah the Meronothite;
ylt.27:31: and over the flock is Jaziz the Hagerite; all these are heads of the substance that king David hath.
ylt.27:32: And Jonathan, uncle of David, is counsellor, a man of understanding, he is also a scribe; and Jehiel son of Hachmoni is with the sons of the king;
ylt.27:33: and Ahithophel is counsellor to the king; and Hushai the Archite is the friend of the king;
ylt.27:34: and after Ahithophel is Jehoiada son of Benaiah, and Abiathar; and the head of the host of the king is Joab.
ylt.28:1: And David assembleth all the heads of Israel, heads of the tribes, and heads of the courses who are serving the king, and heads of the thousands, and heads of the hundreds, and heads of all the substance and possessions of the king, and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty ones, even to every mighty one of valour--unto Jerusalem.
ylt.28:2: And David the king riseth on his feet, and saith, `Hear me, my brethren and my people, I--with my heart--to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and for the footstool of our God, and I prepared to build,
ylt.28:3: and God hath said to me, Thou dost not build a house to My name, for a man of wars thou art, and blood thou hast shed.
ylt.28:4: `And Jehovah, God of Israel, doth fix on me out of all the house of my father to be for king over Israel to the age, for on Judah He hath fixed for a leader, and in the house of Judah, the house of my father, and among the sons of my father, on me, me He hath been pleased to make king over all Israel;
ylt.28:5: and out of all my sons--for many sons hath Jehovah given to me--He also fixeth on Solomon my son, to sit on the throne of the kingdom of Jehovah over Israel,
ylt.28:6: and saith to me, Solomon thy son, he doth build My house, and My courts, for I have fixed on him to Me for a son, and I--I am to him for a father,
ylt.28:7: and I have established his kingdom to the age, if he is strong to do My commands, and My judgments, as at this day.
ylt.28:8: `And now, before the eyes of all Israel, the assembly of Jehovah, and in the ears of our God, keep and seek all the commands of Jehovah your God, so that ye possess this good land, and have caused your sons to inherit after you unto the age.
ylt.28:9: `And thou, Solomon, my son, know the God of thy father, and serve Him with a perfect heart, and with a willing mind, for all hearts is Jehovah seeking, and every imagination of the thoughts He is understanding; if thou dost seek Him, He is found of thee, and if thou dost forsake Him, He casteth thee off for ever.
ylt.28:10: See, now, for Jehovah hath fixed on thee to build a house for a sanctuary; be strong, and do.'
ylt.28:11: And David giveth to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of its houses, and of its treasures, and of its upper chambers, and of its innermost chambers, and of the house of the atonement;
ylt.28:12: and the pattern of all that hath been by the Spirit with him, for the courts of the house of Jehovah, and for all the chambers round about, for the treasures of the house of God, and for the treasures of the things sacrificed;
ylt.28:13: and for the courses of the priests and of the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of Jehovah, and for all vessels of service of the house of Jehovah,
ylt.28:14: even gold by weight, for things of gold, for all instruments of service and service; for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of service and service;
ylt.28:15: and by weight for the candlesticks of gold, and their lamps of gold, by weight for candlestick and candlestick, and its lamps; and for the candlesticks of silver, by weight for a candlestick and its lamps, according to the service of candlestick and candlestick;
ylt.28:16: and the gold by weight for tables of the arrangement, for table and table, and silver for the tables of silver;
ylt.28:17: and the forks, and the bowls, and the cups of pure gold, and for the basins of gold, by weight for basin and basin, and for the basins of silver, by weight for basin and basin,
ylt.28:18: and for the altar of perfume refined gold by weight, and for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubs of gold--spreading and covering over the ark of the covenant of Jehovah.
ylt.28:19: The whole is in writing from the hand of Jehovah, `He caused me to understand all the work of the pattern,' said David.
ylt.28:20: And David saith to Solomon his son, `Be strong, and courageous, and do; do not fear nor be affrighted, for Jehovah God, my God, is with thee; He doth not fail thee, nor forsake thee, unto the completion of all the work of the service of the house of Jehovah.
ylt.28:21: `And lo, courses of the priests and of the Levites are for all the service of the house of God; and with thee in all work is every willing one with wisdom, for every service; and the heads and all the people are according to all thy words.'
ylt.29:1: And David the king saith to all the assembly, `Solomon my son--the one on whom God hath fixed-- is young and tender, and the work is great, for not for man is the palace, but for Jehovah God;
ylt.29:2: and with all my power I have prepared for the house of my God, the gold for things of gold, and the silver for those of silver, and the brass for those of brass, the iron for those of iron, and the wood for those of wood, shoham stones, and settings, and stones of painting and of diverse colours, and all kinds of precious stone, and stones of white marble, in abundance.
ylt.29:3: `And again, because of my delighting in the house of my God, the substance I have--a peculiar treasure of gold and silver--I have given for the house of my God, even over and above all I have prepared for the house of the sanctuary:
ylt.29:4: three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses,
ylt.29:5: even gold for things of gold, and silver for those of silver, and for all the work by the hand of artificers; and who is he that is offering willingly to consecrate his hand to-day to Jehovah?'
ylt.29:6: And the heads of the fathers, and the heads of the tribes of Israel, and the heads of the thousands, and of the hundreds, even to the heads of the work of the king, offer willingly.
ylt.29:7: And they give for the service of the house of God, of gold--talents five thousand, and drams a myriad; and of silver--talents ten thousand, and of brass--a myriad and eight thousand talents; and of iron--a hundred thousand talents;
ylt.29:8: and he with whom stones are found hath given to the treasury of the house of Jehovah, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
ylt.29:9: And the people rejoice because of their offering willingly, for with a perfect heart they have offered willingly to Jehovah; and also David the king hath rejoiced--great joy.
ylt.29:10: And David blesseth Jehovah before the eyes of all the assembly, and David saith, `Blessed art Thou, Jehovah, God of Israel our father, from age even unto age.
ylt.29:11: To Thee, O Jehovah, is the greatness, and the might, and the beauty, and the victory, and the honour, because of all in the heavens and in the earth; to Thee, O Jehovah, is the kingdom, and he who is lifting up himself over all for head;
ylt.29:12: and the riches, and the honour are from before Thee, and Thou art ruling over all, and in Thy hand is power and might, and in Thy hand, to make great, and to give strength to all.
ylt.29:13: `And now, our God, we are giving thanks to Thee, and giving praise to Thy beauteous name;
ylt.29:14: yea, because, who am I, and who are my people, that we retain power to offer thus willingly? but of Thee is the whole, and out of Thy hand we have given to Thee;
ylt.29:15: for sojourners we are before Thee, and settlers, like all our fathers; as a shadow are our days on the land, and there is none abiding.
ylt.29:16: `O Jehovah our God, all this store that we have prepared to build to Thee a house, for Thy holy name, is out of Thy hand, and of Thee is the whole.
ylt.29:17: `And I have known, my God, that Thou art trying the heart, and uprightness dost desire; I, in the uprightness of my heart, have willingly offered all these: and now, Thy people who are found here I have seen with joy to offer willingly to Thee.
ylt.29:18: `O Jehovah, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, our fathers, keep this to the age for the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of Thy people, and prepare their heart unto Thee;
ylt.29:19: and to Solomon my son give a perfect heart, to keep Thy commands, Thy testimonies, and Thy statutes, and to do the whole, even to build the palace for which I have prepared.'
ylt.29:20: And David saith to all the assembly, `Bless, I pray you, Jehovah your God;' and all the assembly bless Jehovah, God of their fathers, and bow and do obeisance to Jehovah, and to the king.
ylt.29:21: And they sacrifice to Jehovah sacrifices, and cause to ascend burnt-offerings to Jehovah on the morrow of that day, bullocks a thousand, rams a thousand, lambs a thousand, and their oblations, even sacrifices in abundance, for all Israel.
ylt.29:22: And they eat and drink before Jehovah on that day with great joy, and cause Solomon son of David to reign a second time, and anoint him before Jehovah for leader, and Zadok for priest.
ylt.29:23: And Solomon sitteth on the throne of Jehovah for king instead of David his father, and prospereth, and all Israel hearken unto him,
ylt.29:24: and all the heads, and the mighty men, and also all the sons of king David have given a hand under Solomon the king;
ylt.29:25: and Jehovah maketh Solomon exceedingly great before the eyes of all Israel, and putteth upon him the honour of the kingdom that hath not been on any king over Israel before him.
ylt.29:26: And David son of Jesse hath reigned over all Israel,
ylt.29:27: and the days that he hath reigned over Israel are forty years; in Hebron he reigned seven years, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three;
ylt.29:28: and he dieth in a good old age, satisfied with days, riches, and honour, and reign doth Solomon his son in his stead.
ylt.29:29: And the matters of David the king, the first and the last, lo, they are written beside the matters of Samuel the seer, and beside the matters of Nathan the prophet, and beside the matters of Gad the seer,
ylt.29:30: with all his reign, and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all kingdoms of the lands.

web.1:5: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
web.1:6: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.
web.1:7: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
web.1:8: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
web.1:9: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
web.1:10: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.
web.1:11: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
web.1:12: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.
web.1:13: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,
web.1:14: the Jebusite, and the Amorite, the Girgashite,
web.1:15: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,
web.1:16: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
web.1:17: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
web.1:18: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.
web.1:19: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
web.1:20: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
web.1:23: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
web.1:28: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
web.1:29: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
web.1:31: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
web.1:32: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
web.1:33: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
web.1:34: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
web.1:35: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
web.1:36: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.
web.1:37: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
web.1:38: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
web.1:39: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
web.1:40: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
web.1:41: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
web.1:42: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
web.1:43: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
web.1:44: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
web.1:45: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
web.1:46: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
web.1:47: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
web.1:48: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.
web.1:49: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
web.1:50: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai: and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
web.1:51: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
web.1:52: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
web.1:53: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
web.1:54: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
web.2:1: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
web.2:2: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
web.2:3: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah; which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight; and he killed him.
web.2:4: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
web.2:5: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
web.2:6: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara; five of them in all.
web.2:7: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.
web.2:9: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
web.2:10: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
web.2:11: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,
web.2:12: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;
web.2:13: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,
web.2:14: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
web.2:15: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh;
web.2:16: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.
web.2:17: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
web.2:18: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
web.2:19: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
web.2:20: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.
web.2:21: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
web.2:22: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
web.2:23: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
web.2:24: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah Hezron’s wife bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
web.2:25: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
web.2:26: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.
web.2:27: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
web.2:28: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
web.2:29: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.
web.2:30: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.
web.2:31: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
web.2:32: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.
web.2:33: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
web.2:34: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
web.2:35: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.
web.2:36: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,
web.2:37: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,
web.2:38: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,
web.2:39: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,
web.2:40: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,
web.2:41: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.
web.2:42: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
web.2:43: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
web.2:44: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.
web.2:45: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
web.2:46: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.
web.2:47: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
web.2:48: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
web.2:49: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena, and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
web.2:50: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
web.2:51: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.
web.2:52: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.
web.2:53: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
web.2:54: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
web.2:55: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
web.3:1: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;
web.3:2: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
